tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /blo gsal ri bong gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i dris lan lha'i rnga bo che lta bu'i gtam zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ ri bong gi rtogs pa brjod pa legs par 'doms pa lha'i rnga bo che lta bu'i gtam/ 'phags pa yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i go skabs yangs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor gang bas mdzes byas shing*/ /phan bde'i 'od stong gdul bya'i dbyings khyab pa/ /mchog gsum bla mar dad brgya'i gtsug gis mchod/ /bde bar gshegs gsung shin tu rmad byung gi /don bzhin legs 'doms phan par smra ba'i ngag /dad ldan skye bo kun gyi tshogs nang du/ /lha yi rnga sgra lta bu'i gtam 'di spro/ /bag med bslang dang dge la bskul ba dang*/ /chos mos lhag pa'i shes rab bskyed pa dang*/ /thar ba dam pa'i chos bzang bsten par 'gyur/ /de phyir rab gsal 'phags pa'i dbyangs 'di nyon/ / de la dam pa rnams kyis rjes su gdams pa ni yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas yin pa'i phyir/ rang gzhan mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i byang chub 'dod pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis legs par 'doms pa la gus pas mnyan par bya'o/ /de yang 'di skad thos so/ /gangs kyi ri bo'i 'gram/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang po'i gdul zhing*/ yon tan kun nas bkod pa'i sa phyogs lhun po rin po che brtsegs pa'i 'dabs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' dri med 'od zer gyi skyed mos tshal/ kun nas dge ba yid bzhin rin po che'i sprin zhes bya ba/ phyogs rnams ni gangs ri'i rwa bas bskor ba/ dbus na nor bu rnam par brtsegs pa lta bu'i ri la/ brag ri'i tshogs dang sman ljongs shin tu rgya che ba nags kyi shing ljon pa mang pos dkrigs pa dang*/ 'bab chu dang lding ka dang mtshe'u du mas brgyan pa/ yid du 'ong ba'i bya dang shing dang me tog dang ri dwags mang pos gang ba/ brag ri'i phug dang rtswa dang lo ma'i khang bu tha dad pa du ma bkod pa/ thar ba 'dod pa'i skye bo bsam gtan pa dag gi bsti gnas rab tu bzang po/

dus bzhir zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin ngang gis 'phel ba/ tshe 'di'i rnam par g.yeng ba dang skye bo mang po'i 'du 'dzi med pa/ bya dang shing dang nags kyi mthongs yid du 'ong ba/ 'bab chu'i rgyun dang me tog kha bye ba'i tshal na bya dang bung ba 'du ba'i sgra las kyang*/ mi rtag pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ bdag med pa dang*/ nye bar zhi ba'i chos kyi glu dbyangs snyan par byung bas/ dka' thub pa dag gi yid rab tu dngas par byed pa/ nags tshal kun tu bzang po'i yon tan bkod pa lta bu ste/ gangs ri'i yul ljongs 'phags pa'i skyed mos tshal/ /yid 'ong me tog bzang po 'phos pa bzhin/ /sna tshogs nyer bkra'i bkod pas mdzes gyur cing*/ /bsam gtan spyod pa dag gis brgyan la ltos/ /tshul 'di sngon dus med pa dag pa'i zhing*/ /yon tan bkod pa shin tu rgya che bas/ /thar pa 'dod pa dag gi yid bzhin gling*/ /srid las rgyal 'dod dag gis bsten par 'os/ /de ltar ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i skyed mos tshal bzang po de dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig na/ shing ka ra bī ra'i ldum bus brgyan pa'i nags khrod me tog kun tu bkram pa/ rtswa dang lo ma'i tshang tshing bkod legs pa na rig pa dang grol ba'i yon tan du mas mdzes pa ri bong blo dang ldan pa zhig kyang 'dug par gyur to/ /zhi ba'i nags na yon tan mchog tshogs can/ /sman shing me tog ljon pas brgyan pa na/ /dul ba'i ri dwags gcig pur gnas pa ni/ /drang srong rnams kyi spyod la 'gran pa bzhin/ /de nas ri bong gi mchog des dka' thub pa dag gi skyed mos tshal blta ba'i phyir 'ongs pa las/ 'bab chu'i 'gram na me tog gi tshogs la bung ba di ri ri sgrog cing*/ shing ljon pa'i yal ga rlung gis g.yo ba'i tshul la bsams nas/ nags kyi yon tan la bsngags pa/ sil khrol lbu ba'i phreng bas brgyan pa yi/ /chu 'gram ge sar rkang drug myos pa'i tshal/ /mthong nas dpag bsam lag rtsed dud pa yis/

/nags kyi na chung rnams la sbran pa bzhin/ /padmo'i tshal gyis bung ba bzung ma thag /ljon pa'i nags tshal khros pas ma bzod de/ /rnam bkra yal ga'i lcug phran g.yo ba yis/ /ge sar rnams la 'khon lan glan pa bzhin/ /chu 'gram me tog bzang po'i skyed tshal du/ /padma'i steng bzhugs bde gshegs bung ba ni/ /chos rnga sgrogs pas kun nas mdzes pa la/ /tshal rnams gus pas dam chos nyan pa bzhin/ /zhes brjod de song ba las/ yang nags kyi mthongs dben zhing nyams dga' ba/ brag ri'i drung dang sman shing lo ma sdug gus mdzes shing*/ dka' thub kyi gnas dang lo ma'i khang bu du ma bkod pa/ yid du 'ong ba'i chu dang shing dang me tog gi rigs mang pos brgyan pa mthong nas bsngags pa/ dwangs pa'i mkha' la gza' skar bkra ba bzhin/ /nags tshal zhi ba yon tan rgyan phreng can/ /dka' thub dpal gyis kun nas mdzes pa ni/ /tshangs sogs 'jig rten na yang sngon med cing*/ /shing rnams lo ma me tog 'bras mang zhing*/ /tshal rnams dus bzhir dga' ba'i tshogs mang la/ /chu rnams lhung sgra snyan pa'i dbyangs mang zhing*/ /nags rnams bsam gtan spyod pa'i tshogs mang mdzes/ /dus rlung ser bus bskyod pa'i shing rnams dang*/ /bya dang ri dwags bung ba'i sgra rnams las/ /dam chos zhi ba tshangs pa'i dbyangs 'byung bas/ /skye bo rnams kyi dad brgya'i 'dab stong g.yo/ /sngon nas legs par sbyangs pa'i las rnams dang*/ /dam pa rnams kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs dag /gnas 'di'i skye rgu rnams la mnyam zhugs pas/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho tha mar byed pa bzhin/ /yon tan gangs ri'i phreng tshogs dang ldan dben zhing nyams dga'i rig pa 'dzin/ /sna tshogs nyer bkra'i bkod pa rab mdzes thar pa dam pa'i skyed mos tshal/ /sman shing me tog 'bras bu'i tshogs dang chu gtsang ngang mos bsten gyur cing*/ gnyis skyes dga' bas glu gar snyan sgrog lha yi skyed tshal ra ba bzhin/ dpag bsam dul ba'i yal 'dab rnams ni ge sar rgyas pa'i 'dab stong bzhin/

/sngo zhing snum pa'i nags khrod rnams ni rma bya'i mgrin pa 'tsher ba bzhin/ /mthil rnams sman ljongs shang shong rnams ni mtho ris sa gzhi bzang po bzhin/ /bya dang ri dwags rtsed 'jo rnams ni lha rnams 'dun sar rtse ba bzhin/ /skyed tshal ra ba me tog g.yo ba'i shing 'chang zhing*/ ngang mos bsten pa'i rdzing bu yid 'ong 'bab stegs can/ /mtho ris grong gi steng du 'dzegs pas mdzes pa gang*/ /lha rnams kyis kyang dga' bar bya ba'i gnas 'di mtshar/ /zhes brjod de song ba las/ bsam gtan gyi bsti gnas rab tu bzang po kha cig na/ mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i nor gyis phyug pa dag /don dang rig pa dang ldan pa'i tshul gyis chos kyi gtam rnam par gtan la 'bebs pa dag mthong nas bsngags pa/ mkha' ni rgyu skar phreng ba can/ /mtsho ni me tog padma can/ /mi ni sna tshogs yon tan can/ /skal bzang 'di dag mdzes so kye/ /zhes so/ /kha cig na phyag dang mchod pa dang mdo dang bzlas brjod la brtson pas/ thun mtshams su bya ba'i dge ba la rab tu 'bad pa dag mthong nas bsngags pa/ dam pa'i rigs can 'di dag dus kun tu/ /g.yel ba med par rtag tu brtson 'grus brtson/ /ring por mi thogs srid mtsho'i mtha' brgal nas/ /zhi ba'i gling mchog myur du mdzes par byed/ /ces so/ /kha cig rab tu zhi ba'i don la yang dag 'jog pa mthong nas bsngags pa/ rang bzhin nye bar zhi ba'i sa phyogs su/ /dul ba'i skye bo bsam gtan spyod pa dag /mi g.yo mi gsung mnyam par gzhag pa ni/ /chos nyid ngang la gnas pas mdzes so kye/ /zhes brjod nas/ bsti gnas pa dag nyul zhing legs par spyod pa'i yon tan la bsngags pas song song ba las/ mthar gyis brag ri'i drung sab mo dang ra bas bskor ba'i gnas shig na rab tu byung ba gzhon nu zhig /rdo leb ha cang yang mi che ba zhig la sngas bcas shing rkang pa brkyangs nas kha bub tu nyal ba mthong ngo*/ /de nas blau gsal ri bong des/

brtan pa yin yang tshul de la/ /snying rje'i dbang gis rab g.yos te/ /brag ri'i drung der phyin par gyur/ /gang du 'jig rten skyong rnams dang*/ /mi bdag rang gi 'khor rnams la/ /brtse bas sems dpa' mchog rnams kyi/ /snying rje brtan la ji ltar reg /sa 'di brtan pa'i ri bcas kun/ /g.yo bas 'jigs pa med rnams kyang*/ /de tshe bag med gyur mthong nas/ /snying rje'i dpag bsam yal 'dab g.yos/ /ji ltar g.yos she na/ de'i tshe 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma'o/ /mtshar byas dal 'byor rin po che'i gru rnyed kyang sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho brgal ba la brtson par mi byed/ rab tu byung yang thar pa dam pa'i chos la brtson pa lhod/ gzhan gyis bsti stang du byed kyang ldan pa dang grol ba'i yon tan med pas byin pa chud gson/ dbang po gsal yang 'chi bar sems pa med pas tshe 'di'i 'khrul pas nyin mtshan 'da'/ legs pa dam pa 'dod kyang 'khor 'das blang dor gyi gnas la rmongs shing dge sdig rgyu 'bras kyi las la gso sbyong mi byed/ phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas la smon yang gnyid dang snyom las kyis dus 'da' ba 'di ni ma legs kyi/ ji ltar phan pa'i thabs shig bya snyam pa na yang bsam pa/ mkhas shing gsal ba dag ni dris shing lan du ldon pas/ dbang po dang bag la nyal shes par byed cing chos ston pa'i phyir/ bdag gis kyang de'i dus la bab bo snyam nas smras pa/ kye ma brag ri'i nyi 'od mgul/ /dben pa yin kyang bag brkyangs te/ /kun tu sbyor ba lhod nas nyal/ /'di 'dra ha cang mi 'os so/ /ngal bar gyur tam chang gis myos/ /mi snyan thos sam nad kyis btab/ /'du shes 'khrugs sam shi bar gyur/ /nyams nyes chen po ci byung ka'i/ /zhes brjod pa dang tshig 'bru gsal ba'i sgra des rab tu byung ba de gnyid sad de/ kha bub pa las cung zad 'greng nas su zhig 'dir 'ongs nas de skad smra bar byed snyam nas bltas pas/

ring zhig gnyid du song ba dang bad kan rab rib kyi dbang gis/ nye bar gyur kyang gsal bar ma mthong nas smras pa/ rang bzhin dben pa brag ri'i drung 'dir ni/ /rang dga'i spyod lam ci bder spyad pa'i phyir/ /phyogs rnams skye bo lta ba rwa bas bsgribs/ /lam srol med par 'jug pa su zhig kye/ /zhes brjod pa dang*/ ri bong gis smras pa/ nga ni su yin phyis nas shes par 'gyur/ /dben par bag med nyal ba'i rgyu 'di ci/ /dris pa'i don rnams gang yin gsal bar smros/ /phun tshogs 'grub pa legs par skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes brjod pa na/ gdod ri bong gcig brag ri'i drung du 'ongs pa mthong nas slar gan rkyal du nyal nas smras pa/ dkar gsal brag ri'i nyi 'od mal gdan la/ /nyal ba gang lags ngal bar ma gyur cing*/ /chang dang mi snyan 'du shes ma 'khrul la/ /nad kyis ma btab shi bar gyur pa'ang min/ /rang bzhin bag yangs rang dbang bde ba'i mchog /gang zhig mthong nas legs par nyal ba yi/ /gtan tshigs dam pa gang yin rab bsnyad kyis/ /dul ba'i gzugs can blo gsal ri bong nyon/ /mi rnams mtho dman che dang chung rnams kyi/ /skyid sdug thams cad rang bzhin dal brel tsam/ /rang dbang sos dal dben par nyal ba 'di/ /skyid pa'i mchog tu mthong nas nyal ba lags/ /bya ba'i las kyang zin pa'i skabs med la/ /'jig rten brel do byed dgos de bas mang*/ /chos kyang de 'dra byas pas zin dus med/ /nam yang mi zin bzhag nas nyal ba lags/ /brtson dang mi brtson sgrim glod thams cad kyang*/ /phugs su rkyang gcig zin pa su la'ang med/ /ma zin lhag ma rjes la bya dgos med/ /bya byed bzhag nas rang dal nyal ba lags/ /sems kyis spros shing lus kyis brtson gyur kyang*/ /bya ba'i las la 'di zhes thug pa med/ /sos dal nyal yang tshe gang de yis 'khyol/ /gang byung ngang la rang babs nyal ba lags/ /nyal zhing gnyid pas zas rnams 'ju ba dang*/ /nad pa yin kyang zug rngu med pa dang*/

/mya ngan can yang sdug bsngal brjed la sogs//phan yon mthong nas gang bder nyal ba lags/ /sos dal lus la gnyid kyi 'byor pa can/ /rang dbang bag yangs yid bzhin rin po che/ /g.yo 'gul med par nyin mtshan dal ba 'di/ /dal 'byor rin chen don yod byas pa snyam/ /nyal ba dran med 'od gsal snying po ste/ /rnam rtog rang 'gags yid la byed pa med/ /chos nyid rang yang de rang yin pa snyam/ /dmigs med babs la rang bzhin nyal ba lags/ /nags nang zhi ba'i blo gsal ri bong yang*/ /khra dang ce spyang 'tshe ba med gnas su/ /rang bzhin bag yangs bde ba'i tshang bcas te/ /dal ba gnyid kyi bsam gtan sgom par mdzod/ /ces brjod de/ yang cung zad gzhogs phab ste nyal ba na/ ri bong gis/ tshul de dag gi lan ldon rigs pa dang ldan pas smras pa/ kye ma bzhin bzang rab tu byung ba khyod/ /don rnams dpyod pa'i blo mig rgyangs thung yang*/ /log pa'i lam la dbang po ma gsal bar/ /brtse ba'i gdams ngag rigs pa'i don la nyon/ /'di ltar lha mi'i 'jig rten thams cad na/ /dal ba tsam zhig skyid pa ma lags kyi/ /chos dang 'jig rten phun tshogs sems bde ba/ /gang lags de kun skyid pa'i mchog tu gsungs/ /gal te sos dal nyal ba skyid yin na/ /ngal dub chad dang nad pa sprang po yang*/ /skyid 'gyur sems dal nyal te de ltar min/ /don rnams 'byor slad brtson 'grus dpe med mdzod/ /gang la phun tshogs shin tu brel ba ste/ /nyin mtshan mi dal don rnams rigs pas bsgrub/ /de yis rang bzhin bde skyid sbyin pas na/ /don rnams 'byor slad brtson 'grus dpe med mdzod/ /chos dang 'jig rten bya ba gang rnams la/ /zin dang mi zin dbye ba rnam gnyis te/ /spyi tsam las la zin pa med na yang*/ /bye brag las la so sor zin pa mthong*/ /'di ltar dus ring 'jig rten bya ba dang*/ /nyin gcig zin pa'i las kyi khyad par ltos/ /chos kyang spyi tsam zin pa med na yang*/

/bye brag gang bsgrub mthar ni zin par nges/ /dus ring 'grub pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /tshe rabs chos kyis 'grub pa'i khyad par gang*/ /rgyal dang de sras 'phags pa'i tshogs la ltos/ /dar cig bsgrubs nas de ma thag zin pa'i/ /mig rgyangs thung ngus bya bzhag chung du ste/ /chen po rnams la de lta ma yin pas/ /don chen las la ngang chen rab tu bsrings/ /phyi rjes lta ba skyes bu dam pa'i lugs/ /don rnams 'byor slad brtson 'grus dpe med mdzod/ /gang gis gang du las kyi 'phro brtsam pa/ /chos dang 'jig rten bya ba gang ci rung*/ /rigs pa'i don rnams rjes la bstud dgos te/ /bzo rigs la sogs 'phro rnams bstud pa bzhin/ /'jig rten las la gang gis 'phro brtsam pa/ /de yi rjes la bstud par ma nges kyang*/ /chos la nges pas rgyud gcig tshe rabs bsgrub/ /don rnams 'byor slad brtson 'grus dpe med mdzod/ /sems la dran rgu dngos su mi sgrub kyang*/ /rigs pa'i don rnams kun gyis sgrub pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang tshul de'i rjes su 'gro dgos pas/ /don rnams 'byor slad brtson 'grus dpe med mdzod/ /brtson dang mi brtson mnyam du song ba med/ /brtson pas bsgrubs rnams phun tshogs mngon mtho la/ /sos dal skyid snyam de lta ma lags pas/ /don rnams 'byor slad brtson 'grus dpe med mdzod/ /nyal zhing gnyid pas bad kan 'phel ba dang*/ /mkhris pa ldang zhing ldan 'dus 'jug pa dang*/ /dbang po 'grib cing tshe la gnod pas na/ /don rnams 'byor slad brtson 'grus dpe med mdzod/ /nyal zhing gnyid pas don rnams 'chor ba dang*/ /bag zon med pas dgra rnams 'jug pa dang*/ /'dre rnams glags tshol nyes pa tshad med pas/ /don rnams 'byor slad brtson 'grus dpe med mdzod/ /nyal zhing gnyid pas dal 'byor don yod na/ /ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i 'gro ba dang*/ /mtha' 'khob kla klo'i mi yang don yod 'gyur/

/mi khom 'byor pa spang phyir de lta min/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka'i mi lus rin chen 'di/ /don med chud zos stong bar ma song bar/ /da res thar pa dam pa'i chos sgrubs la/ /don rnams 'byor slad brtson 'grus dpe med mdzod/ /'di ltar nyes pa'i lam la rab brten nas/ /de yi yon tan brjod cing zhen pa ni/ /mun pa'i lam la brten nas mun pa yi/ /bsngags pa rab brjod 'byung po'i bya tshogs bzhin/ /khyod kyis bdag la tshul de bskul na yang*//log pa'i lam der bdag cag yongs mi 'gro/ /de bas khyod nyid de las log na legs/ /'di phyi'i legs pa gzhan dag skye bar 'gyur/ /kye grogs po tshul der 'jug cing zhen pa'i ngang tshul can ni nyes par 'gro ba'i ded dpon srin mo'i gling du gru'i kha lo bsgyur ba dang 'dra ste/ kho bo ni khyed la mchog tu brtse bas rta'i rgyal po bha la ha ltar dus su 'doms shing*/ log par ltung ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob par byed cing*/ legs par smra ba'i gtam gyi me tog rgyun chags pa'i rjes su gdams pa'i khyad par bzang po gzhan yang nyon cig

/'gro drug nang nas mi yi lus rnyed dkon/ /de bas dam chos spyod pa'i lus rnyed dkon/ /dal 'byor don yod spyod pa'i lus rnyed dkon/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /gang du skyes pa'i mtshan mo kho na nas/ /'chi bar phyogs pa kun gyi chos nyid de/ /bden zhing rtag par 'dzin pa mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /tshe srog g.yo ba nub ka'i nyi ma bzhin/ /da lta yod kyang med pa myur du 'ong*/ /'gyur ba'i chos la yid brtan mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /myur du 'chi nges snum zad mar me bzhin/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba myur du nub nges pas/ /'khrul snang yul la zhen par mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /'dus kyang 'bral ba lam mthun mgron po bzhin/ /'khor 'dabs mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun thams cad kyang*/ /'bral ba'i chos la gdung sems mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /bsags kyang 'dzad pa rdzing bu'i 'khyil chu bzhin/ /'byor kyang mi brtan sgyu ma'i nor rdzas la/ /zhen chags 'ching ba'i ser sna mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /mthon po dma' ba mkhar kha'i me shor bzhin/ /chen por gyur kyang las tshul rgyang ring bas/ /nga rgyal che grags rlom sems mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /'pho bzhin 'gyur ba rmi lam gnyid sad bzhin/ /mtho ris thob kyang yid brtan mi rung bas/ /tshe 'dir zhen pa'i 'du shes mi khom gya/ /snyoms las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /dus kyi snyigs ma shing 'dab lhags pa bzhin/ /rgan rabs gzhon rabs skal mnyam du ma 'das/ /bdag kyang 'chi nges rtag 'dzin mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /'chi rkyen ma nges glo bur thog babs bzhin/ /gar 'chi cis 'chi nam 'chi ma nges pas/

/lus sems rten la yid brtan mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzod me 'obs bzhin/ /bzod pa'i blag med bde ba'i skabs med pas/ /khams gsum rigs drug 'khor bar mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /ngan song ngan 'gro gcong rong zab mo bzhin/ /lan gcig chud nas thar pa'i go skabs dka'/ /mar 'gro'i las ngan sdig pa mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /mtho ris dga' bde g.yang kha'i rtsed mo bzhin/ /las kyi dbang gis slar yang ngan song ltung*/ /'pho zhing 'gyur la chags par mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /khams gsum rigs drug zo chu 'khor ba bzhin/ /gcig nas gcig brgyud bde sdug rnam par 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i gnas la zhen pa mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /skye shi'i 'khor lo shing rta'i 'phang lo bzhin/ /yang 'khor yang ldog sdug bsngal mu mtha' yas/ /'khor ba'i chos la chags sred mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /mya ngan 'das pa lha yi skyed tshal bzhin/ /dga' bde'i snang ba grangs med thob 'tshal bas/ /thar 'dod rnams kyis le lo mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /bshes gnyen dam pa rgya mtsho'i ded dpon bzhin/ /zhi ba'i gling du 'dren par mdzad de bsten/ /sdig pa'i grogs dang 'grogs par mi khoms gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /dam chos zhi ba gru gzings zam pa bzhin/ /'khor ba'i chu bo sgrol la nan tan bskyed/ /gtan bde 'dod rnams phyi bshol mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /dge sdig blang dor zhing sa'i ngo mthon bzhin/ /dkar nag las la gso sbyong snying por bya/ /dal 'byor don med chud zos mi khom gyi/

/snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /zhi ba'i don gnyer rgya mtsho'i tshong pa bzhin/ /gtan du legs pa yid bzhin nor bu 'dor/ /'khor ba'i bde 'bras gnyer ba mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /thang lhod med pa gzhu mo'i rgyud bsgrengs bzhin/ /'gyur med ngang nas zab mo'i chos la spyod/ /le lo phyi bshol ma dad mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /don chen sgrub pa'i skyes bu mkhas pa bzhin/ /g.yel ba med par nyin mtshan brtson 'grus brtsam/ /tha mal rang ga'i kun spyod mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /dben pa bsten pa dul ba'i ri dwags bzhin/ /dman sa bzung la sgrub pa snying por bya/ /da res rnam g.yengs 'du 'dzi mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /rang sems dul ba rta mchog 'dul sbyong bzhin/ /sna tshogs rtag tu rang rgyud dul bar bya/ /nye bar ma zhi bag med mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /tshe gang don yod sngon gyi dam pa bzhin/ /rtag tu chos bsam snying po'i don la 'bad//don med 'khrul pa'i bya ba mi khom gyi/ /snyom las spongs la dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /mdor na da res dal 'byor thob dus 'dir/ /'khor 'das chos la spang blang rab shes pas/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma thar lam byang chub sgrubs/ /'di phyir legs pas rjes su gdams pa lags/ /zhes brjod pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba de yang mngon par dad de thar pa 'dod pas lus drang por bsrang zhing thal mo sbyar nas smras pa/ yon tan rang bzhin can khyod 'gro ba'i gnyen*/ /skye bo ma 'dris pa yang bshes nyid na/ /rtag tu bsten pa rnams la lta ci zhig /ngo mtshar mchog gyur khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /mkhyen rab mtsho chen yon tan padmo can/ /thugs rje'i chu gter rab tu bzang po las/ /legs 'doms chos kyi btung chu gnyer bar 'tshal/

/brtse bas bdag la go skabs dbye bar mdzod/ /ces brjod pa na/ ri bong gi mchog des rjes su gdams pa'i snod du rig nas smras pa/ gang zhig 'di phyi'i legs pa gnyer 'dod pas/ /nor dang chang dang bud med bag med spongs/ /dam pa bsten dang dad brtson thos bsam tshol/ /bsam gtan sgom dang dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /yon tan mchog dkar 'di dag rnams bsten pas/ /srid gsum pha rol legs pa'i gling 'gro ste/ /bde gshegs zla ba mkha' la rnam mdzes sam/ /rgyal sras ded dpon rgya mtshor gru mdzes bzhin/ /zhes brjod pa na rab tu byung ba des bsam pa la/ /gang na skyes bu blo gros blun pa dag ni gang zhig yongs su bsgrub par bya ba'i don la brtag pa dang dpyad pa med par bab col du 'jug pas/ cung zad dka' bar mthong ba de'i tshe gya tshoms su 'dor bas ngal ba 'bras bu med par byed pa yin la/ mkhas shing gsal la mdzangs pa dag gis ni/ thog mar sgrub pa'am dor bar bya ba'i cha la skyon dang yon tan gyi cha dbye bar/ rang gi nus pas brtags te legs par dpyad nas 'jug pas/ phyis ni rab tu dka' ba'i gnas la yang 'jigs pa'ang mi blta bas rtsom pa gang dag mthar phyin pa'i phyir skyes bu dam pa'o zhes yongs su grags te bdag kyang de'i rjes su 'jug par bya ba'i phyir/ re zhig rang gi nus pas 'jug pa'am/ ldog par bya ba'i don la blang dor gyi khyad par ji lta bu snyam du rjes su gdams pa'i gnas la brtags shing dpyad pas/ de'i tshe spang bar bya ba'i chos de dag kyang 'jig rten na legs pa'i yon tan gyi cha shas kyis brgyan par yang mthong la/ blang bar bya ba'i chos de dag kyang phal cher yongs su sgrub par dka' ba'i mtshan nyid can du mthong ste/ re zhig dang po nor gyi yon tan la bsngags pa/ gang zhig yod na kun gyis bkur ba'i gnas/ /'byor pa lha yi dpal 'dra skye bos bstod/ /skye rgu'i khyu mchog kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin/

/nor dpal yon tan mthong nas sgrub par 'os/ /nor med skye bo bzhi mdo'i sprang po bzhin/ /kun gyis spong zhing dman phyir bzhad gad gnas/ /phyi nang gang gi'ang gral du mi chud pas/ /nor dpal yon tan mthong nas sgrub par 'os/ /nor 'byor dam pas gang la brgyan pa des/ /don rnams kun kyang phun tshogs ngang gis 'grub/ /yid bzhin dag las 'dod rgu'i char rgyun bzhin/ /nor dpal yon tan mthong nas sgrub par 'os/ /nor med tshe na kun gyis spong ba ste/ /bzang po'i drin gyis khyab pa'i 'khor 'dabs dang*/ /mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun 'dor bar 'gyur la ltos/ /nor dpal yon tan mthong nas sgrub par 'os/ /gang la nor 'byor yod na skye bo'i tshogs/ /ma bsdus par yang ngang gis kun 'du ste/ /yid 'ong mtsho la ngang mo 'du ba bzhin/ /nor dpal yon tan mthong nas sgrub par 'os/ /nor med skye bo gros 'dun blo brtan yang*/ /nyan mkhan med la kun gyis 'chal bar brtsi/ /yin lugs thog tu babs kyang da dung dmod/ /nor dpal yon tan mthong nas sgrub par 'os/ /nor gyis 'byor na mi gshis rtsing po yang*/ /sgam por 'dzin pas de yi ngag la nyan/ /nyes par gyur kyang da dung gus pas 'dud/ /nor dpal yon tan mthong nas sgrub par 'os/ /nor med tshe na rgan yang gzhon yang rung*/ /rigs dang yon tan cho 'brang ci yod kyang*/ /kun gyi mthar lhung gral yang 'og tu lus/ /nor dpal yon tan mthong nas sgrub par 'os/ /nor 'byor gang la sna tshogs skyon chags pa/ /rigs ngan yon tan med la rmongs na yang*/ /kun gyis bstod cing de yi rjes su 'brang*/ /nor dpal yon tan mthong nas sgrub par 'os/ /nor med tshe na mkhas btsun bzang yang rung*/ /thabs kyis dmod cing bsod nams med par 'dzin/ /'khor gyis spangs la snying rje'i yul byed pas/ /nor dpal yon tan mthong nas sgrub par 'os/ /nor dang ldan na 'chal rmongs ngan pa yang*/

/kun gyis bkur la de yi kha 'dzin byed/ /gus pas 'dud la de yi rjes 'jug pas/ /nor dpal yon tan mthong nas sgrub par 'os/ /nor med tshe na 'jig rten skye bo dang*/ /dam chos zhugs pa'i gnas rnams gang yang rung*/ /mi rnams nang du legs par mi tshud pas/ /nor dpal yon tan mthong nas sgrub par 'os/ /nor zhes bya ba'i yid bzhin rin po che/ /kun la dgos shing skye rgu'i bde 'byung gnas/ /dam chos sgrub la'ang med du mi rung bas/ /nor dpal yon tan mthong nas sgrub par 'os/ /zhes brjod pa na/ don de ha cang yang mi rigs la/ dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la tshul dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ blo gsal gyi mchog des smras pa/ kye kye 'jig rten 'di na mi rnams la/ /gang gang 'byor pa dam pas brgyan gyur pa/ /de yi nyes pa shin tu tshad med de/ /rang rang sdug bsngal mtha' yas bshad kyis nyon/ /cha shas med la tshol ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ /chu bor srog 'dor tsha grang bkres skom sogs/ /che rgus sgrub kyang phun sum tshogs rab dkon/ /cho nges gdungs ba'i sdug bsngal char mi phod/ /gang la yod pa 'tsho skyaung sdug bsngal mang*/ /gang du bsrungs kyang khe spogs tshol ba dang*/ /gang gis 'tshe dang tha mar srog la rgol/ /gang dag nor gyi nyes pa tshad med do/ /nor zhes bya ba kun tu nor bas te/ /kun dang rtsod cing chags dang ser sna 'phel/ /chos las nyams shing chags sdang nyon mongs skye/ /nor zhes ming yang don dang mthun par grags/ /cung zad 'byor na khengs shing nga rgyal la/ /re zhig rgud na zhum zhing mya ngan skyed/ /chos dang 'gal zhing dam pa rnams kyis dmad/ /'khor bar 'ching ba'i nyes pa mtha' yas ldan/ /nor gyi ched du bzang po'i rigs 'dor la/ /yon tan spyod pa dam pa kun tu spong*/ /grags pa ngan pas phyogs rnams khyab gyur la/ /'dod pas gdung phyir nyes pa dpag tu med/ /nor gyis kun tu brel la sdug bsngal mang*/

/sgo gsum ma zhi mi dge rgyun chags ldan/ /bgrang gzhal tshe na'ang ngag 'khyal rgyun mi 'chad/ /srid pa'i 'khri shing nor gyi sdug bsngal ltos/ /sna tshogs thabs tshul mang pos rab bsags pa'i/ /nor mang phun sum tshogs pas mngon mtho yang*/ /tha mar 'dor la re zhig kun gyis spyod/ /sdig kun rang gi rjes 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam/ /ji tsam 'byor yang lto dang gos nyid tsam/ /lhag ma gzhan dang thun mong gnyer gyis tshul/ /gzhan don sems pa med pas bsod nams med/ /chog shes med pa nor gyi nyes pas gzir/ /nor 'byor mi 'byor nyin mtshan mnyam 'da' la/ /zla ba lo dang tshe gang mthar phul nas/ /'chi ba'i dus su yod kyang khyer dbang med/ /gcig pu nyid 'gro nor gyi sdug bsngal soms/ /nor ni rtsod bcas cung zad tsam gyi phyir/ /pha ma mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun tshogs 'bral zhing*/ /dpon slob grogs mched dam tshig zhig ral byed/ /bslab gsum 'chor bas nor gyi nyes kun gzigs/ /mi brtan bslu ba sgyu ma'i 'byor pa yang*/ /rmi lam dang 'dra dar re'i nor gyi phyir/ /sna tshogs sdig pa shin tu mtha' yas bsags/ /gtan du 'khrul pa nor gyi nyes kun soms/ /nor zhing nor ba'i nor gyis 'khor bar 'khyams/ /sred cing sred pas sred ldan yi dwags skye/ /'byor zhing 'byor yang 'byor pa don med pas/ /nyes mang nyes 'byung nyes pa'i nor la gzigs/ /dam pas dmad cing chos min bag med gnas/ /thar lam spangs shing bag med 'du 'dzi'i gzhi/ /zug rngu mang bas bze re rgyun mi 'chad/ /nyes kun rang bzhin nor gyi sdug bsngal soms/ /sems la chog shes legs pa'i blo med na/ /sgyu ma'i nor rdzas yod kyang je dgos te/ /'di tsam yin zhes 'byor pa'i go skabs med/ /grags sred 'phel ba nor gyi nyes kun soms/ /nor la g.yeng pas mkhas pa'i 'dun ma 'jig /nor la sred pas btsun pa'i 'dul khrims nyams/ /nor la dga' bas bzang po'i dam chos dmad/

/nor la nyes mang mtha' yas mkhyen par mdzod/ /deng dus mi yi srid pa don yod la/ /dam chos rin chen sgrub par 'dod rnams kyis/ /nor gyi nyes kun rab tu dran byas nas/ /chog shes ldan pas dam chos sgrub par 'tshal/ /zhes brjod pas/ rab tu byung ba de'i sems nor la sred pa las bral te chos sgrub pa la spro par gyur to/ /de nas rab tu byung ba des bsam pa/ nor ni chos la bar du gcod pa'i nyes pa du ma'i skyon chags pa nyid spangs bar bya yis/ chang ni legs pa dam pa'i yon tan mang la chos dang 'jig rten kun la dgos pa'i phyir spang du mi rung bas bsten par bya'o snyam nas yon tan la bsngags pa/ gang gi rang bzhin sngon gyi drang srong bzhin/ /dul ba'i gzugs bzang zhi ba'i rgyan phreng can/ /kun nas mdzes pa nags kyi ri bong mchog /mi yul bdud rtsi chang gi yon tan gson/ /yid 'ong mtho ris lha yi grong khyer nas/ /bdud rtsi'i thigs pa mchog gcig lhung ba na/ /'dzam gling skye bo yongs kyi bsod nams las/ /'bru rnams bcud chags chang gi dngas mar gyur/ /kha dog ro ldan sbrang rtsi lta bu la/ /dri bsung phun tshogs lha yi bdud rtsi bzhin/ /mthong na yid dga' bsten pas 'bral mi phod/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /'thung bas bde la myangs na zhim pa ste/ /khong du song bas lus sems mchog tu bde/ /snang ba bde khrol chos nyid rtogs pa 'dra/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /'thung ba'i rjes la blo bde rang mal du/ /rtog med ngang la rgya yan gnyid phebs pas/ /ting 'dzin 'od gsal bsam gtan 'byongs ba 'dra/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /'thung ba'i mod la dga' ba'i gtam rnams dang*/ /yid 'ong snyan pa'i glu dbyangs du ma 'byung*/ /gzhan la mi 'jigs spobs pa dpag tu med/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /ro mchog brgya ldan bdud rtsi chang nyid la/

/gtso bo'i ro mchog mngar skyur kha ba gsum/ /phyogs su ma chad gcig la kun tshang bas/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /dang por mngar ba cung zad skyur ba'i ro/ /'bol zhing 'khril la kha bas 'bral mi phod/ /brtags shing ngo mtshar ro mchog dpag tu med/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /'thung bas lus bde gzi brjid 'phral la skye/ /mgrin pa'i mtsho rdol gre 'gyur phun sum tshogs//snang ba yid bde sems la dga' bde rnyed/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /'du ba snyoms shing nad rnams kun la phan/ /khyad par pad rlung 'dus pa sel bas na/ /sman rnams nang nas bdud rtsi sman gyi mchog /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /gang du 'phrad na brel ba'ang dal 'gyur zhing*/ /'thung ba'i mod la sems kyi sdug bsngal 'gags/ /nyin mtshan yun thung song ba mi tshor bas/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /skyid sdug kun la rang gzhan dgos pa dang*/ /che chung kun gyis yongs su spyod pa dang*/ /gzhi byes kun tu med thabs med pa'i phyir/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /don rnams sgrub kyang gleng ba'i gzhir dgos la/ /mdza' bshes 'dus kyang ngo dga'i skyes su dgos/ /gnyen 'dun tshogs kyang sna len phyir dgos pas/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /mthon por gyur pa'i mi dbang rgyal po nas/ /bla ma mchog dang bshes gnyen dam pa dang*/ /khrims la dbang ba'i mi chen che rgus bsten/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /yul khams so so'i grong gi mi rnams dang*/ /sde dgon phal dang dben pa'i ri ngogs na'ang*/ /longs spyod kun gyi gzhi mar bsten pas na/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /sgrim por rlom pa'i bka' gdams 'dul 'dzin dang*/ /mtshan nyid pa dang jo gdan la sogs kyang*/ /dben pa'i gnas su dga' bas sten par byed/

/zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /skye bo rnams kyang ci yod chang la skyel/ /btsun pa rnams kyang chos gos chang la 'jog /grub chen rnams kyang nyi ma gte bor 'jog /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i sgrub rdzas yin pa dang*/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod pa dang*/ /srung ma dam can rgya mtsho bsten pa dang*/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i longs spyod yin pa'i phyir/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /dwangs ma 'phel bas lus sems bde ba dang*/ /bde drod skyes pas ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang/ /rig ngar thon pas rtogs pa 'char ba'i phyir/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams 'du ba dang*/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshogs rnams dgyes pa dang*/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /mi rnams kun kyang de la bsten pa dang*/ /'dre rnams kun kyang de la dga' ba dang*/ /lha rnams kun kyang dgyes par rol ba'i phyir/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /de dag la sogs yon tan dpag tu med/ /brjod kyis mi lang lha yi bdud rtsi bzhin/ /mi yul btung ba'i ro mchog dam pa 'di/ /dga' zhing sred pas rab tu bsten pa lags/ /zhes brjod pa dang*/ don de nyid ha cang yang rigs pa ma yin pas/ legs pa dam pa la gzung ba'i phyir/ ri bong gi mchog des smras pa/ gang la bsten pas log pa'i lam 'gro zhing*/ /sdig dang nyon mongs bag med kun gyi gzhi/ /chos dang 'jig rten phun tshogs nyams pa'i rgyu/ /myos byed chang gi nyes kun bshad kyis nyon/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /smra byed gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /brjod pa mang zhing gsang gtam lhug par sgrogs/ /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /bre mo'i gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/

/shags dang bzhad gad glu gzhas bag med 'phel/ /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /sred byed gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /yang 'thung yang sred ngoms shing chog mi shes/ /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /'gyur byed gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /kun spyod 'gyur zhing gtam la zung mi thub/ /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /rjed byed gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /dran pa nyams shing rnam dpyod blo gros stor/ /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /phyi bshol gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /de ring phyin pas sang dang gnang du 'gor/ /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /rgud byed gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /da lta 'byor yang myur du rgud par 'gyur/ /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /'chor byed gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /don rnams 'chor zhing legs par 'grub dus med/ /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /'jig byed gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /chos dang 'jig rten phun tshogs myur du 'jig /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /gnod byed gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /tshad mkhris 'phel zhing gnyan dang rims nad spor/ /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /'grib byed gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /mig la sogs pa dbang po'i dwangs ma 'grib/ /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag

/'chol byed gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /bag zon shor bas dgra 'dres glags skabs 'tshol/ /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /nyams byed gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /gom tshugs 'chor bas tshe dang srog la rgol/ /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /nyes byed gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /'phral phugs nyams pa'i blo ngan 'dun gros gleng*/ /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /'khrug byed gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /'thab rtsod 'khrugs long phung khrol bcom brlag byed/ /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /myos byed gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /bag med tho co smyo spyod skyur 'gong byed/ /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /phung byed gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /pha ma brdung zhing bu smad sdug la gtad/ /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /bag med gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /skyugs shing 'gyel la ngo tsha sba gsang bral/ /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung nas khong du song ma thag /'chag byed gdon de snying la zhugs gyur pas/ /bzo rigs yon tan 'jig rten bya ba 'chag /myos byed chang 'di deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /'jig rten dag na chang la skyon mang la/ /de bas dam chos sgrub la nyes che bas/ /thar pa dam pa don du gnyer rnams kyis/ /myos byed chang ni rab tu spang bar mdzod/ /'thung nas bag med sred pa 'phel ba dang*/ /gnyen po med pas bslab gsum 'chor ba dang*/ /bzang po'i grags pa nyams par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /myos byed chang ni rab tu spang bar mdzod/

/gang gis 'thung pas 'du shes 'grib 'gyur zhing*/ /'chad dang kha ton thos bsam sgom la sogs/ /dge ba'i sbyor ba kun la gnod pas na/ /myos byed chang ni rab tu spang bar mdzod/ /gsang sngags sgrub la'ang thabs kyi yan lag tsam/ /bag med myos pa kun tu dgag pa ste/ /ngu 'bod gnas su skye bar gsungs de'i phyir/ /myos byed chang ni rab tu spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig lam gyi grogs su bsten pa yang*/ /rlung sems grub pas nyes pa med kun gyi/ /thabs gyur shin tu dben par gsang bas na/ /myos byed chang ni rab tu spang bar mdzod/ /tha mal skye bo kun gyi tshogs nang du/ /bag med kun tu spyod pa gsang sngags min/ /gsang ba mngon du phyung bas bka' chad 'byung*/ /myos byed chang ni rab tu spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig 'thung bas dran pa 'chol 'gyur la/ /bskyed rdzogs thun las g.yel zhing gsang sgo 'chol/ /legs pa'i chos las nyams pas ngan 'gror ltung*/ /myos byed chang ni rab tu spang bar mdzod/ /gang gis myos pas dad dang nges 'byung 'grib/ /khro dang tshig rtsub khong ngan zug rngu 'phel/ /'thab cing rtsod pas dam tshig nyams pa'i rgyu/ /myos byed chang ni rab tu spang bar mdzod/ /gang gis 'thung bas bab col tshogs rnams smra/ /chos la bsten yang khong khros rang rgyud bsreg /dam pa rnams la mi snyan skur ba 'debs/ /myos byed chang ni rab tu spang bar mdzod/ /chos dang 'jig rten kun la skyon yin pas/ /bag med chang la bsten pa dam pas dmad/ /gang zhig kun la legs par sgrub 'dod pas/ /myos byed chang gi nyes kun bshad la nyon/ /mdor na nyes kun rtsa ba chang yin zhes/ /sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyis legs par bstan/ /bum pa'i rabs der legs par gsungs de bzhin/ /myos byed chang ni legs par spang bar mdzod/ /ces brjod pas chang la sred pa'i blo gros ngan pa spangs nas chos sgrub pa la spro bar gyur to/ /de nas yang rab tu byung ba des bsam pa/

chang ni de bzhin nyes pa mang bas spang du rung gi /bud med ni legs pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pas bsten par bya'o snyam nas/ de'i bsngags pa smras pa/ mdzes sku zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor gang ba la/ /yon tan ches bkra'i gzugs brnyan legs bris pa/ /mkhyen brtse'i 'od dkar ri bong 'dzin gzugs can/ /bud med dam pa'i bsngags pa brjod kyis gson/ /rgyal srid dge ba rin chen sna bdun gyi/ /nang nas ches mchog bud med rin po che/ /thams cad kun tu bkra shis dpal 'phel bas/ /bud med dam pa'i yon tan mchog tu bsngags/ /lus phra'i rdzing bu yid 'ong padma can/ /sred ldan skye bo 'du ba'i gzhir gyur la/ /rtse dga'i dus ston bzang pos rab brgyan pa/ /bud med dam pa'i yon tan mchog tu bsngags/ /'jig rten skye bo kun gyi tshogs nang du/ /gang zhig shar bas phyogs rnams mdzes gyur pa/ /skar ma'i nang nas ri bong 'dzin gzugs bzhin/ /bud med dam pa'i yon tan mchog tu bsngags/ /rab mdzes dga' ba rtse dga'i chu gter mchog /ngang mo'i khyu lding yid 'ong padmo'i mtsho/ /na chung gzugs brnyan 'dzin dang mtshungs pa snyam/ /bud med dam pa'i yon tan mchog tu bsngags/ /gzugs mdzes mchog tu 'phags pa'i dga' ma la/ /gos bzang rin chen sil khrol mdzes pa ni/ /mchod sdong rin chen dra bas spras pa bzhin/ /bud med dam pa'i yon tan mchog tu bsngags/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin la g.yo ba'i smin dkyus can/ /rab dkar so yi phreng bas mdzes gyur pa/ /kunda'i tshal du zla zer shar ba bzhin/ /bud med dam pa'i yon tan mchog tu bsngags/ /lus phra'i rkang 'thung rnam bkra'i lo 'dab can/ /'dod ldan rlung gis bskul ba'i glu snyan dang*/ /lag rtse'i gar las myos ldan 'bod pa bzhin/ /bud med dam pa'i yon tan mchog tu bsngags/ /gang du 'dug pas phyogs rnams mdzes gyur pa/ /mtho ris bu mo dga' bas 'brangs ba bzhin/

/sred ldan rnams kyi mig gi bdud rtsir byed/ /bud med dam pa'i yon tan mchog tu bsngags/ /gzugs bzang lta na sdug cing yid 'ong ba/ /dul ba'i rang bzhin ngang tshul phun sum tshogs/ /rtag tu tshig 'jam dal zhing snyan par smra/ /bud med dam pa'i yon tan mchog tu bsngags/ /grong rnams nang na bud med rgyan gyi mchog /lam srang mdzes shing myos ldan dga' ba skyed/ /snyan pa'i glu len bstod pa'i tshig 'bru gsal/ /bud med dam pa'i yon tan mchog tu bsngags/ /khyim gyi lha mo yid 'ong skal bzang ste/ /'jig rten srid 'phel bu nor phun sum tshogs/ /gang la ci dgos bza' btung longs spyod ster/ /bud med dam pa'i yon tan mchog tu bsngags/ /gang zhig yod pas don rnams phun tshogs shing*/ /phyi nang skye bo kun gyis bsten gyur la/ /lus sems bde byed lha yi btsun mo bzhin/ /bud med dam pa'i yon tan mchog tu bsngags/ /'jig rten nor rnams nang nas bud med mchog /'dod rgu'i don rnams sgrub la mkhas pa dang*/ /mdzangs shing gsal la lags pa kun gyi gzhi/ /bud med dam pa'i yon tan mchog tu bsngags/ /chos la'ang grogs te gsang sngags zab mo yi/ /dbang dang lam zab snying po'i dus dgos la/ /lha rnams kun la'ang yum dang bcas pa'i phyir/ /bud med dam pa'i yon tan mchog tu bsngags/ /mdor na chos dang 'jig rten gang la yang*/ /bud med yon tan rang bzhin rgyan gyi mchog /yid 'ong phun tshogs lam la rab gnas pas/ /skal bzang bud med dam pa bsten pa lags/ /zhes brjod pa dang*/ don de thar pa thob pa'i tshul dang 'gal la/ re zhig 'jig rten na yang skyon dang bcas pa mthong nas/ de las ldog pa'i phyir ri bong gi mchog des smras pa/ gang zhig mtha' yas nyes pa'i chu gter du/ /thog mtha' med nas rab zhugs nyon mongs can/ /nyes pa'i tshogs rab 'phel ba'i bud med la/ /nye bar bsten pa'i nyes kun bshad kyis nyon/

/bud med ces pa g.yo sgyu'i rang bzhin te/ /bsam brjod 'dzol la mi brtan gya gyu mang*/ /ming yang g.yon can zhes su grags pa yin/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /phyi nang kun tu zer spyod ma nges pas/ /smra mchu mang bas don med gzeng rtsa'i gzhi/ /phrag dog che bas mi snyan skyel bsu byed/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /mthun par bsten yang dgrar 'gyur ma nges la/ /gzhan dang rtsod bcas 'khrug long du ma'i gzhi/ /ser sna che bas dge ba'i gegs shing byed/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /mdzes par snang yang gos dang rgyan gyi mdangs/ /de dang bral na 'jigs shing skyugs bro bas/ /gya gyu'i sgeg chos mi gtsang 'dam rdzab khrod/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /gzhan las g.yo sgyu nyon mongs che bas na/ /nad rnams mang zhing khro dang rdzun la dga'/ /mthong dang thos dang reg pas dug rnam langs/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /spyod lam phal cher gzhan sems bslu zhing bsgyur/ /re zhig mdzes kyang brtags shing mi legs pa'i/ /rang bzhin mthong nas sems kyi phreng thag chod/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /thog mar mthun yang bar du 'thab cing 'grogs/ /tha mar 'bral la mya ngan sdug bsngal slong*/ /bran bzhin 'bod kyang sems la chog shes med/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /rang gis ci yod de la gtad na yang*/ /de yis blo rkun logs su sog brun byed/ /ji tsam bsags kyang 'byor pa'i dus med pa/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /bag med skye bo gzhan dag sten byed pas/ /rang gi rigs nyams tshe dang srog la rgol/ /gzhan gyis bskyed pa'i bu tshas phan mi thogs/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /chung ma'i dbang gyur pha dang ma yang gsod/ /byams pa'i gnyen bral sdig la mi bya med/ /'di phyi nyams shing kun gyis smad pa'i gnas/

/phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig yod pas chung du 'gro ba'i phyir/ /chung ma zhes bya'i ming yang don dang mthun/ /chags sred 'phel zhing tshe srog g.yo ba'i phyir/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /bkra shis 'byor pas brgyan pa'i khyim nang du/ /gang zhig zhugs pas thams cad med gyur pa/ /nyes byed 'byung pos dkrugs shing gtor ba bzhin/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /gang rnams mthun zhing mtsho ltar mi g.yo ba/ /gang zhig zhugs pas rlung gis dkrugs pa bzhin/ /gang du dgra ltar 'thab cing 'bral bar 'gyur/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /dang por yid 'ong mthun pa'i lha 'dra yang*/ /bar du rtsod cing 'grogs pa'i mi yi tshul/ /tha mar za byed bdud mo ma rungs pa/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /de dag la sogs nyes pa'i tshogs mang bas/ /re zhig 'jig rten na yang skyon chags la/ /dam chos sgrub la de las nyes mang bas/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /thar lam byang chub zhi ba gnyer rnams kyi/ /bar chad bdud du g.yon can bud med che/ /kun gyis dmod cing dam pa'i tshul dang 'gal/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig thos bsam sgom la zhugs pa yang*/ /gang dang 'phrad pas de las nyams 'gyur zhing*/ /mthong dang ma mthong rnam smin dpag tu med/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig gzhan don byed par zhugs rnams kyang*/ /gang dag bsten pas grags pa nyams 'gyur zhing*/ /phrin las chung bas phan pa med par 'gyur/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /mkhas pa yin yang kun gyis dmod pa dang*/ /'dun pa nyams pas gzhan la phan mi thogs/ /spyod pa dman phyir phal bas bzhad gad gnas/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /btsun pa yin yang 'dul khrims zhig pa yis/ /srung ba'i lhas 'dor kun gyi yid mi 'ong*/

/nyes pa lci bas 'di phyir sdug bsngal thob/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /bzang po yin yang chags sred nyon mongs 'phel/ /tshe 'dir 'khrul zhing 'dod yon rang dgar spyod/ /mig rkyen ngan pa'i nyes pa gzhan la 'go /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /dad dang nges 'byung dam chos brtson pa yang*/ /gang dang 'phrad na tshe 'di'i dbang song ste/ /thar lam stor bas gtan du 'khor bar 'khyams/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /bsam gtan don la yang dag 'jog rnams kyang*/ /gang dang 'phrad pas legs pa'i chos nyams te/ /ri ngogs spangs te sa mtha'i grong 'dabs 'grim/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /gsang sngags lam la'ang rim pa tha dad de/ /tshangs spyod ldan pa gsum pa'i rten med pas/ /grol lam rang lus yid kyi phyag rgya tsam/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /tshangs spyod min yang tha mar mi rung ste/ /lam gyi grogs gyur mtshan nyid tshang ba dkon/ /bab col bsten pas rnam smin dpag tu med/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /lha rnams kun la yum dang bcas pa ni/ /snang stong thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug brda/ /tha mal 'jig rten 'khrul pa'i lugs bzhin min/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /gang dang nye la skyon gyi rang bzhin 'go /chos la zhugs kyang thar lam nyams pa'i rgyu/ /bslab gsum srung sdom gnyen po'i rtsal 'chol bas/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /sngon nas legs pa'i bsod nams shas chung bas/ /nyes pa med kyang de yi shas 'go zhing*/ /don med sgro skur gzhan rkyen sdig pa'i gnas/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /me tog zla mdzes rgyal po'i khab tu bsad/ /dpal gyi ri la klu sgrub gshegs pa yang*/ /g.yon can bud med dag gi le lan yin/ /phung khrol rtsa ba bud med spang bar mdzod/ /mdor na chags sred nyon mongs rgya mtsho'i gnas/

/brgal dka' 'khor ba'i rang bzhin mi bzad pa/ /bud med gzugs can nyes pa'i chu gter la/ /dga' ba gang lags rab tu spang bar mdzod/ /rgyas par dkon mchog brtsegs pa las brgya pa/ /mdzang blun dran pa nyer gzhag 'dul ba lung*/ /de dag rnams su rgyal bas gsungs de bzhin/ /bud med nyes kun gzigs nas spang bar mdzod/ /ces brjod pas/ bud med la mngon par dga' ba'i sems dang bral te chos sgrub pa la spro bar gyur to/ /de nas rab tu byung ba des bsam pa/ bud med ni de ltar nyes pa mang po'i gzhir gyur pas spang par gdams pa shin tu legs kyi/ rang bzhin bag yangs su spyod pa'i dga' ba ni yon tan rin po ches brgyan pa'i phyir/ rtag tu de la bsten pa kho na'o snyam nas bsngags pa smras pa/ dpag med dus nas legs pa'i chu gter du/ /thugs rje'i spyan mchog me tog rab bkra zhing*/ /mkhyen brtse'i gnyis skyes bzang po'i sgra 'byin pa/ /blo gsal ri bong bag yangs bsngags pa gson/ /rang bzhin ma bcos ji bzhin lhun grub pas/ /sgo gsum gang dag rang bab lhug pa'i tshul/ /grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams rjes 'gro ba/ /bag yangs yon tan bzang po'i rang bzhin lags/ /sus kyang ma bcings rang dbang thob gyur pas/ /gzhan dang mi bstun snang ba bde yangs pa/ /rang dga'i lam la spyod pa ci bder gnas/ /bag yangs yon tan bzang po'i rang bzhin lags/ /gang bde'i spyod pa mtho ris dga' bde'i gzhi/ /glu gar rtsed 'jo rang gzhan skyid pa'i tshul/ /dran rtog sna tshogs shes rab rig pa'i rtsal/ /bag yangs yon tan bzang po'i rang bzhin lags/ /ched du bsdams pa sdug bsngal 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /bcos ma'i spyod pa rang bzhin zog po'i tshul/ /ma bcos phyal ba gnas lugs gshis kyi babs/ /bag yangs yon tan bzang po'i rang bzhin lags/ /skyid sdug thams cad rang dbang gzhan dbang ste/ /rang dbang bag yangs sgo gsum lhug par gnas/

/ma bcings rgya grol nyin mtshan snang ba bde/ /bag yangs yon tan bzang po'i rang bzhin lags/ /chos dang 'jig rten snang ba thams cad la/ /gdog pas rang bcings yangs pas gzhan 'ching bas/ /gu yangs rang grol spyod lam bde phyam me/ /bag yangs yon tan bzang po'i rang bzhin lags/ /de dag la sogs legs pa'i tshul mang bas/ /bag yangs lam ni rab tu bzang po ste/ /padmo'i mtsho ru ngang mo 'jug pa ltar/ /bag yangs rdzing bur dga' bas bsten par gyis/ /zhes brjod pa na/ don de rigs pa ma yin pa'i lam las ldog pa'i phyir/ ri bong gi mchog des smras pa/ dam pa rnams dang dman pa'i rang bzhin dag /bag yod med pa'i khyad par che ba nyid/ /re zhig 'jig rten na yang gsal bar mngon/ /bag med nyes kun mang ba'i tshul la nyon/ /sgo gsum ma bsdams zhi des mi ldan la/ /kun spyod rang ga gzu lums spyi brtol can/ /ya rabs dam pa'i tshul dang 'gal bas na/ /bag med nyes kun deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /spyod lam rtsing bas ngo tshas ma bsdams shing*/ /gtsang sbra med pas bre mo'i gtam mang ba/ /'jig rten na yang spre'u 'dzin pa'i lugs/ /bag med nyes kun deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /bzang po'i spyod tshul dam pa mi shes la/ /mchog rnams bkur ba'i rim pa ma mthong zhing*/ /'dug dang bza' btung tshul yang mi shes pa/ /bag med nyes kun deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /'di bya'i tshad med rang bzhin smyon pa'i tshul/ /dran rgu brjod la rtse rgod mchong zhing rgyug /kun rtog rags la nye bar ma zhi ba/ /bag med nyes kun deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /glu gar rtsed 'jo bre mo'i gtam la dga'/ /phan tshun 'dzing dang dgod dang rgyags pa 'phel/ /chags sred nyon mongs phyi phyir ldang gyur pa/ /bag med nyes kun deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /rgyan po 'gyed dang lus la lta ba dang*/ /'dus par dga' dang nye bar ma zhi ba/ /thar pa dam pa'i chos lam nyams pa'i rgyu/ /bag med nyes kun deng nas spang bar mdzod/

/gang dag bag med lam la bsten gyur pa/ re zhig 'jig rten na yang smad pa ste/ /skye bo ngan pa rnams kyi gral du bzhag /bag med nyes kun deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /dam chos sgrub la bag dang ldan dgos shing*/ /dam pa rnams kyi rjes su 'jug dgos phyir/ /dam pas bag med dmad la gdams par mdzad/ /bag med nyes kun deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /sde snod gsum yang bag yod zhi dul de/ /lus sems sdom zhing phyi nang gtsang sbra bsten/ /bslab gsum dbang byas rang sems 'dul ba'i phyir/ /bag med nyes kun deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /theg chen ldan pa'i yon tan rlabs che ba/ /rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub par zhugs rnams kyang*/ /rtag tu bag yod lam la rab bsten pas/ /bag med nyes kun deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /gsang sngags rgyal po rdo rje theg pa yang*/ /dam tshig sdom pa zhib mor lhur byed pas/ /nyin mtshan kun tu bag yod snying por byed/ /bag med nyes kun deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /mdor na chos dang 'jig rten legs rgu la/ /bag yod ces pa'i mchog de don yod byed/ /bag med legs kun nyams pa'i gzhir gsungs pas/ /bag med nyes kun deng nas spang bar mdzod/ /rgyas par mdzang blun sdong po bkod pa dang*/ /bslab pa kun las btus dang spyod 'jug sogs/ /bag yod bsten pa'i mdo bstan gsungs pa dag /rgya cher gzigs la bag med spang bar mdzod/ /ces brjod pas/ bag med pa'i gnas la bsten pa spangs te/ legs par chos sgrub pa la spro bar gyur to/ /de nas yang rab tu byung ba des bsam pa/ de ltar spang zhing dor bar bya ba'i tshul de dag sla mod kyi/ blang zhing bsgrub par bya ba'i don de dag bsten par dka' bas/ da dung legs par brtag par bya'o snyam pa las/ thog mar dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par dka' ba'i tshul la bsams te smras pa/ zhi ba'i mkha' la rab gsal thugs rje'i dbyings/ /chos dkar yon tan gza' skar phreng tshogs can/

/legs pa'i 'byung gnas ri bong dam pa lags/ /bshes gnyen bsten par dka' ba'i tshul 'di gson/ /deng sang dus ngan lnga brgya'i tha ma la/ /bshes gnyen rnams kyang chos ltar bcos pa mang*/ /gang la bsten kyang phyogs ris chags sdang 'phel/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag kyang bsten par dka'/ /la la gos dkar rnam grangs rgya che yang*/ /'jig rten ma spangs tshe 'di'i dbang du song*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzis g.yengs/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag kyang bsten par dka'/ /la la mchog tu btsun par khas 'che yang*/ /phra mo bsrung zhing chen po khyad du gsod/ /gzhan la sdang za rang rgyud ma dul bas/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag kyang bsten par dka'/ /la la bzang po'i grags pa rlabs che bas/ /chos dang 'jig rten rmongs pa'i kun spyod la/ /blun pos ngo mtshar skye ba'i 'bar rgyug tsam/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag kyang bsten par dka'/ /la lar shes bya'i yon tan grangs mang yang*/ /chos brgyad ma bral nga rgyal rlom sems can/ /khengs shing ma dul gzhan rgyud 'ba' zhig bsreg /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag kyang bsten par dka'/ /la lar legs pa'i yon tan 'gas 'byor kyang*/ /'dod pas gdungs la ser sna'i drwa bas bcings/ /rang gis spyod dam gzhan la sbyin mi nus/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag kyang bsten par dka'/ /la la dben par sgrub la zhugs na yang*/ /'du shes chung la phyogs ris bdag ltas khengs/ /mdo rgyud mi shes zab mo'i gnas la rmongs/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag kyang bsten par dka'/ /la lar rig sngags yon tan ldan na yang*/ /chags sred ma spangs khyim thabs bu tshas 'brel/ /kun spyod ngan la kha khyer ngo so mtho/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag kyang bsten par dka'/ /la la skyon bral dam par rlom na yang*/ /yun ring bsten na 'gal 'du'i gnas mang la/ /gang la mi rung bya byed shin tu dka'/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag kyang bsten par dka'/

/la la lam bzang 'gro ba'i ded dpon yang*/ /'grogs shing mgu dka' nyes pa phra mo'ang 'dren/ /rtag tu bag 'khums brgyad bkag rgyun mi 'chad/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag kyang bsten par dka'/ /la la mthar thug theg pa'i don mnga' yang*/ /thun mong theg pa'i bslab gsum 'gal 'du can/ /bzang ngan brtags dka' ma nges the tshom gzhi/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag kyang bsten par dka'/ /'jig rten dag na bshes gnyen mi 'dra zhes/ /grags pa de yang don dang re mthun zhig /nye bar bsten la zug rngu bskyed pa'i phyir/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag kyang bsten par dka'/ /mdor na deng sang 'jig rten grags ngo na/ /mthong thos gyur pa'i bshes gnyen thams cad la/ /so so'i skyon res gos par mthong pa'i phyir/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag kyang bsten par dka'/ /gang zhig kun gyis mthong bar ma gyur par/ /sbas pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa 'ga' srid na'ang*/ /bsten par 'os te rnyed pa'i go skabs dkon/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag kyang bsten par dka'/ /zhes brjod pa na/ don de log pa'i lta ba ngan pa'i mur lhung bas na/ de las ldog pa'i phyir ri bong gi mchog des smras pa/ dus gsum snga phyir gshegs pa'i rgyal ba dang*/ /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i yab/ /grub mchog rnams kyi yon tan ji snyed pa/ /dge ba'i bshes las byung phyir yon tan nyon/ /sngon dus gdul bya las rab dag rnams la/ /rgyal ba dngos dang 'phags rnams 'dren par gyur/ /skye bo dag pa'i snang ba rgya che bas/ /'bras bu'i dus der grol ba mang ba lags/ /deng sang snyigs ma'i gdul bya log rtog rags/ /rgyal ba byon yang thul bar ma gzigs pas/ /dge ba'i bshes su sprul nas 'dul bar gsungs/ /de phyir dag pa'i snang ba rgya skyed cig /snyigs dus 'gro kun las kyis bsgribs gyur pas/ /skyon bral rgyal ba byon na mi mthong phyir/ /skyon yon 'dres mar snang tshul dge ba'i bshes/

/gang mos gzugs kyis gdul bya 'dul ba lags/ /rang rgyud dag na kun kyang dag mthong la/ /ma dag snang ngor kun kyang skyon bcas mthong*/ /bad kan mig ser yod med bye brag gis/ /dung gcig dkar ser tha dad mthong la ltos/ /gzhan la skyon mthong de kun rang gi skyon/ /bzhin dang me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /khams gsum rigs drug srid pa'i sems can kun/ /rang skyon ma dag 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang ltos/ /bzang po'i yon tan can la'ang skyon mthong na/ /gzhan lta ci smos deng sang skal ba ngan/ /yang dag dge ba'i bshes la skyon smra na/ /gang yin de kun thar lam byang chub bral/ /deng 'dir zhi ba byang chub gnyer rnams kyis/ /thar pa'i lam ston dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten/ /skyon la mi brtags yon tan rjes dran pas/ /dam pa rnams kyi rjes su 'brang bar bya/ /skye ba dam pa rnams la gang mnga' ba'i/ /skyon ni brdzun la yon tan bden pa'i phyir/ /blo yi stobs kyis nyes pa zil gnon pas/ /lhag pa'i sems kyis dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /skye rgu'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen la/ /rgyal ba dngos kyi 'du shes nyer bzhag cing*/ /bka' drin lhag par gus pa cher bskyed cing*/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /'jig rten kun na mkhas par grags pa dkon/ /tshig re'i gnas kyang slob pa'i dka' las ltos/ /tshig don mkhas pa'i yon tan dran mdzod la/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /btsun pa'i gnas kyang de bas bya dka' ste/ /nyin re bsnyen gnas bsrung ba'i dka' ba ltos/ /rtag tu tshangs spyod yon tan dran mdzod la/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /bzang por grags pa de bas mchog tu dkon/ /tshe 'di'i chags sdang spang bar dka' ba ltos/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul zhig yon tan dran mdzod la/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /sna tshogs yon tan phyogs med mchog tu dkon/

/phyogs re'i gnas la slob pa'i dka' ba ltos/ /mkhyen rab tshad med yon tan dran mdzod la/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /gzhan phan yon tan gnas re'ang mchog tu dkon/ /shes kyang gzhan la phan pa'i dka' ba ltos/ /rlabs chen phan thogs yon tan dran mdzod la/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /dben pa'i gnas su zhi ba sgrub pa dkon/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi spang bar dka' ba ltos/ /gcig pur gnas pa'i yon tan dran mdzod la/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /rig sngags brtul zhugs grub pa rab tu dkon/ /bgegs rigs 'byung po 'dul dka'i don la ltos/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug yon tan dran mdzod la/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /dam pa'i rang bzhin gzigs pa rgyang ring bas/ /dgos pa'i dbang gis don gnyis sgrub pa la/ /'gal 'dur snang ba rang skyon 'khrul pa yin/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /dam pa nyid ni blo chen mgu dka' la/ /tha mal spyod dang mi mthun 'grogs dka' zhing*/ /rtag tu bag 'khums legs pa'i yon tan yin/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /gzhan don brtse ba can rnams gdul bya yi/ /chos dang 'jig rten nor ba cher dgag phyir/chung ngu 'gog cing tshar gcod rjes su 'dzin/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /skye bo dam pa rnams ni thugs brtse bas/ /nye 'khor gdul bya 'di ltar bskyang bya'i phyir/ /rtsub mos gdams kyang 'di ltar zhi ba lags/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /dam pa'i mdzad spyod rtag tu gzhan gyi don/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i rjes su mthun par 'jug /gang mdzad gnas kun legs pa dam pa yin/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /dam pa'i rang bzhin rtag tu dge ba ste/ /ji ltar mdzad kyang dge ba 'ba' zhig 'byung*/ /mig rgyang thung ngus 'gal 'dur rtog pa nor/

/skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /theg pa'i rtse mor son pa'i dam pa la/ /bslab gsum gong mar yon tan kun 'du bas/ /thun mong nyes med 'gal 'du'i log lta dor/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /thun mong lam zhugs thun mong 'gal ba skyon/ /theg mchog zhugs rnams mchog dang 'gal ba skyon/ /mchog dang thun mong 'gal 'du mi gnas pas/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /mdor na deng sang rang rang yon tan gyis/ /'gro don mdzad rnams ngo mtshar sprul pa'i rigs/ /rgyal ba'i rnam sprul mchog tu gus bskyed la/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /rang nyid legs pa gang zhig gnyer 'dod pas/ /de nyid ldan na de don gnyer slad du/ /gus pas rtag bsten skyon la lta ba dor/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /chu bo brgal phyir mnyan par bsten pa ltar/ /srid mtsho brgal phyir bla mar bsten pa dang*/ /bka' bzhin sgrub la mi mnyes pa rnams spang*/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /dam par nye ba gnod pa'i gzhir mthong nas/ /bshes gnyen rang bzhin me dang 'dra brjod pa/ /de dag bdud kyis byin brlabs gsang tshig yin//skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /dam pa rnams ni gang dang nye ba na/ /de yi yon tan lhag par der 'go ste/ /ri rab gser gyi ri la bya gnas bzhin/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /thar ba 'dod pas dam pa nye bar bsten/ /'bral ba med par bkur sti sri zhu bya/ /de yis byin rlabs yon tan dngos su 'jug /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /deng sang dam pa mngon du gyur rnams la'ang*/ /sna tshogs skyon mthong bsten par mi 'dod na/ /sbas pa'i dam pas su la ci zhig phan/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /gal te sbas par bsten du chug na yang*/ /rang sems ma dag de la skyon mthong nges/

/da lta'i rnams dang skyon yon mtshungs pas na/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /gang zhig rang las yon tan lhag gyur pa/ /de nyid bkur 'os dam pa'i rigs yin la/ /yon tan mang ldan kun gyis phyag bya'i 'os/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /gang la dam chos yon tan lhag gyur pa/ /'jig rten skyon gyis brdzi bar mi nus te/ /chos mchog yon tan 'jig rten spangs de'i phyir/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /re zhig skyon dang yon tan rnams 'dres kyang*/ /yon tan phyir du de la bsten 'os te/ /'jig rten bzo rigs yon tan bslab pa bzhin/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /dam pa'i skyon yon mthong ba rang gi sems/ /spel mar shes pas dag pa'i snang ba sbyang*/ /ma dag log par lta ba rnam par dor/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /de ltar sna tshogs thabs tshul du ma yis/ /rang sems dag pa'i snang ba rgya bskyed la/ /thar pa dam pa'i lam bzang bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /zhes brjod pas/ dam pa rnams la skyon du lta ba spangs nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa la spro bar gyur to/ /de nas yang rab tu byung ba des bsam pa/ de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa lags mod kyi/ dad pa ni mchog tu bya dka' bas bsten par mi nus so snyam nas smras pa/ rab mdzes mchog tu zhi ba'i gangs ri la/ /yon tan chos dkar snang ba rgya che bas/ /ma lus phyogs kyi mthar khyab ri bong mchog /dad pa'i rang bzhin skye bar dka' bas gson/ /sngon nas goms pa'i rang bzhin chung ba dang*/ /tshe 'dir dad pa'i yul yang nyung ba dang*/ /rtog pa'i rkyen yang shin tu mang bas na/ /yang dag dad pa'i rang bzhin skye ba dka'/ /dang ba'i dad pa mchog gsum yul can yang*/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs tsam ste mthong mi nus/ /gzugs brnyan bems po gzhan dang khyad ci yod/

/yang dag dad pa'i rang bzhin skye ba dka'/ /chos kyang lung rnam tshig ste bems po dngos/ /rtogs pa bskal don gzhan yin mngon ma gyur/ /brtags shing dpyad na don spyi'i rnam pa tsam/ /yang dag dad pa'i rang bzhin skye ba dka'/ /bems po'i rang bzhin yi ge'i glegs bam yang*/ /gtsug lag khang rnams rnyings pas 'o brgyal la/ /bkur sti med pas dad pa'i yul ma gyur/ /yang dag dad pa'i rang bzhin skye ba dka'/ /dge 'dun rnams kyang ma brtags gzugs brnyan tsam/ /brtags shing dpyad na so so'i skyon mang bas/ /grong ba'i skye bo phal dang mtshungs pa snyam/ /yang dag dad pa'i rang bzhin skye ba dka'/ /che chung kun la gnas dang longs spyod dang*/ /so nam khe spogs 'dod yon mi dgos med/ /sde tshan chags sdang nyon mongs chags sred 'phel/ /yang dag dad pa'i rang bzhin skye ba dka'/ /'dod pa'i dad pa 'khor 'das blang dor de/ /bden bzhi'i 'dor len deng sang byed pa dkon/ /thams cad tshe 'di'i bde ba gnyer ba'i phyir/ /yang dag dad pa'i rang bzhin skye ba dka'/ /'khor ba'i gnas na'ang lha mi'i bde mchis la/ /zhi ba sgrub la dka' spyad sdug bsngal mang*/ /'khor 'das bden bzhi'i dbye ba brtag dka' bas/ /yang dag dad pa'i rang bzhin skye ba dka'/ /yid ches dad pa dkar nag rgyu 'bras te/ /chos lam sgrub pa kun kyang ldog pas na/ /kun gyi yid ches yul du ji ltar gzung*/ /yang dag dad pa'i rang bzhin skye ba dka'/ /mi dge spyod rnams tshe ring dpal 'phel la/ /dge ba can dag de las log mthong nas/ /phan tshun 'chol bas rgyu 'bras yid ches gang*/ /yang dag dad pa'i rang bzhin skye ba dka'/ /mdor na dad pa'i yul rnams rnyed dka' la/ /kun gyi yid ches tshad mar ma gyur bas/ /de la bsten pa'i dad pa ji ltar rung*/ /de phyir dad pa'i rang bzhin skye bar dka'/ /zhes brjod pa na/ don de nyid dam pa dag gis dmad pas de las rab tu ldog pa'i phyir/

ri bong gi mchog des smras pa/ yon tan rab bsags yid 'ong 'phags pa'i nor/ /gang zhig yod pas legs pa kun 'byung zhing*/ /nyes spong zhi ba thar pa dam pa'i lam/ /chos dkar rab bzang dad pa'i bsngags pa nyon/ /rgyal ba rnams ni dus kun bzhugs gyur pas/ /skye rgu rnams la nyin mtshan rtag tu gzigs/ /phan bde'i lam la 'god pa'i phrin las mdzad/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /bde gshegs gzugs brnyan thams cad bzo sprul pa/ /rgyal bas byin brlabs 'gro kun mchod pa'i zhing*/ /bems po gzhan dang 'gran du yod ma lags/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /chos dkar dam pa bskal don gzhan de yang*/ /dam pa rnams kyi gsung dang thugs la gnas/ /bstan pa'i rang bzhin 'gro la mngon gyur pas/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /glegs bam yi ge'i gzugs kyang sprul paragasungs/ /legs pa'i lam ston blang dor mig 'byed pa'i/ /'gro ba'i dkar po rnam par 'phel byed yin/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /dge 'dun rang bzhin rgya mtsho lta bu ste/ /tshu rol mthong ba rnams kyis brtag bya min/ /lhar bcas 'gro kun bsod nams zhing gi mchog /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /'dod pa'i khams 'dir brten pa'i 'gro kun la/ /khams kyi zas dang btung pas 'tsho dgos pas/ /nor dang rdzas la sred pa snang na yang*/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /sngon dus grong rnams dad ldan skye bos gang*/ /bsod snyoms spyod pas 'tsho bar gyur mod kyi/ /deng sang nus min rang la bdog pas 'tsho/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /rab tu byung la phal pa'i skyon chags kyang*/ /dge ba'i bag chags bzang po rjes 'brel bas/ /thos bsam sgom dang kha ton la sogs spyod/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /dag snang tshul khrims dman zhing nyams gyur kyang*/

/bskal bzang 'di yi 'dren pa tha ma'i tshe/ /mos pa'i bstan la grol ba thob par gsungs/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i nyan thos mchog tu nyams gyur kyang*/ /skyes phal rnams las 'bum 'gyur gyis 'phags pa/ /me tog tsam pa'i dpe yis gsungs de bzhin/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /deng sang tshul bzhin spyod pa nyung na yang*/ /'khor 'das bden bzhi blang dor tshad mar gnas/ /'di la the tshom nor ba'i blo yin pas/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /'khor ba'i bde 'bras 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal te/ /thar lam dka' spyad bde chen dam pa'i lam/ /mthar thug bde dang sdug bsngal khyad yod pas/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /dkar nag las ni bde sdug yid ches gnas/ /gang dag ldog nas su spyod dman bar 'gro/ /dam pa rnams ni tshul dang 'gal mi byed/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /dge spyod sdug la sdig spyod skyid mthong ba/ /da lta'i gang yin sngon gyi las yin la/ /da lta'i las kyis phyi mar bde sdug byed/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /mi dge spyod rnams tshe 'dir bde ba gang*/ /sngon las dge pa'i lhag ma tsam zhig yin/ /da lta'i sdig pas phyi ma ngan 'gror ltung*/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /dge ba can yang tshe 'dir sdug pa mang*/ /sngon las mi dge'i lhag ma'i rnam smin yin/ /da lta'i dge bas phyi ma'i bde ba thob/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /mdor na dad pa'i yul gang dag pa la/ /ma dad log par rtog pa bdud kyi las/ /ngan pa spangs la dag snang rgya bskyed la/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /gang zhig lha mi'i nang nas mchog rnams la/ /dad pa'i gos bzang rin chen rgyan phreng mdzes/ /dman pa rnams la cung zad med pas na/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/

/gang la dad pa med la chos skal bral/ /'phags pa'i rigs nyams thar lam byang chub med/ /srid mtshor 'khyams shing rtag tu bde bas phongs/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /dad pa nor rnams nang nas rin po che/ /'di phyi'i legs pa gang yin char 'babs pas/ /klu dbang yid bzhin dbang ba'i mchog las 'phags/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /dad pa zas rnams nang nas bde ba'i zas/ /ting 'dzin yid bzhin dga' ba skyed pas na/ /'dod pa'i bza' btung kun las khyad par 'phags/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /dad pa'i gos rnams nang nas mchog gi gos/ /ngo tsha khrel yod bag dang rab ldan pas/ /lha mi'i gos mchog dam pas char mi phod/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po'i skyed bar mdzod/ /dad pa rgyan rnams nang nas mdzes pa'i mchog /yon tan rang bzhin skye bo dam pa mtshon/ /rgyal bas bsngags shing 'jig rten gsum gyis bstod/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /dad pa gnas rnams nang nas kun gyi mchog /dam pa'i bsti gnas yid bzhin mtshungs pa med/ /lha mi'i khang bzang mchog rnams kun las 'phags/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /dad pa grogs rnams nang nas mchog gi grogs/ /tshe rabs bgrags kyang rtag tu 'bral mi shes/ /skyo ngal med pas rtag tu phan bde byed/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /dad pa 'khor rnams nang nas nye ba'i 'khor/ /rmi lam na yang bdag gi rjes su byed/ /ci 'dod sgrub la dge ba'i las su byed/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /dad pa gnyen rnams nang nas nye ba'i gnyen/ /legs pa ston cing nyes pa 'gog pa dang*/ /dge ba'i phyogs la grogs dang don byed pas//dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /dad pa bshes rnams nang nas mdza' ba'i bshes/ /mchog tu nye zhing rang snang chos la bsgyur/ /bde sdug kun gyi dus su bsdongs bas na/

/dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /dad pa mgon rnams nang nas skyabs kyi mchog /ngan 'gro 'gog cing mtho ris dga' bde ster/ /'khor ba spangs shing mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /dad pa ston pa'i nang nas rlabs po che/ /gang zhig yod pas legs pa kun bsgrubs nas/ /mthar thug rgyal ba'i 'byor pas mdzes par byed/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /dad pa chos rnams nang nas rtsa ba ste/ /dam pa rnams kyi lam bsang shing rta che/ /'di phyir legs pa kun gyi gzhi yin pas/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /dad pa'i yon tan bsngags pa'i gter mdzod la/ /dad ldan rnams kyis rtag tu bsten bya zhing*/ /dad pa'i yul la dang ba'i sems ldan pas/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /ces brjod pas/ dam pa rnams la mchog tu gus pas/ dad pa'i rang bzhin bzang po bskyed pa la mos par gyur to/ /de nas yang rab tu byung ba des bsam pa/ de ltar dad pa'i lam la bsten pa ni mchog tu skal ba bzang bas blang bar rung gi brtson 'grus ni bya dka' bas sgrub par mi nus so snyam nas smras pa/ 'dod ldan bdud rtsi'i bdag po skye rgu'i gnyen/ /rig byed dge ba gang las 'byung ba bzhin/ /skal bzang yon tan kun 'byung ri bong mchog /brtson 'grus rang bzhin skye bar dka' bas gson/ /gang la brtson yang thug mtha' med pa dang*/ /ji tsam brtson yang zin pa med pa dang*/ /legs par brtson yang nyes ba 'ga' srid pas/ /brtson 'grus rang bzhin skye bar dka' ba lags/ /gang zhig brtson pas nyes pa byas pa bzhin/ /le lo can rnams yon tan 'phel gyur pa/ /'jig rten 'di na gsal bar mngon pas kyang*/ /brtson 'grus rang bzhin skye bar dka' ba lags/ /gang la brtson pas bza' btung 'tsho gos tsam/ /le lor gnas kyang rang bzhin babs kyis 'byung*/ /phugs su don mtshungs 'bras bu dal ba med/

/brtson 'grus rang bzhin skye bar dka' ba lags/ /gang zhig chos la'ang rnam pa mtshungs pa dang*/ /'ga' zhig cha bebs rang bzhin gnas pa dang*/ /brtson pa med kyang kun gyis mchog 'dzin pas/ /brtson 'grus rang bzhin skye bar dka' ba lags/ /sngon nas goms pa'i rang bzhin rlabs chung la/ /tshe 'dir 'khrul ba'i snang ba grangs mang zhing*/ /le lo gsum yang rtag tu 'byung nye bas/ /brtson 'grus rang bzhin skye bar dka' ba lags/ /lus ngag 'jug pa shin tu mi srun zhing*/ /tha mal bya byed mchog tu 'phro bzhin la/ /chos kyi don yang sgrub par rab dka' bas/ /brtson 'grus rang bzhin skye bar dka' ba lags/ /sgo gsum ngal ba 'di yang sdug bsngal la/ /brtson pa'i rang bzhin 'di yang mtha' med cing*/ /rtag tu 'bad pa 'di yang mi nus pas/ /brtson 'grus rang bzhin skye bar dka' ba lags/ /tshe rabs sgrib pa'i mun pa mtha' yas shing*//yang dag dge ba'i cha shas grangs nyung bas/ /bdag 'dras rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nam zhig thob/ /brtson 'grus rang bzhin skye bar dka' ba lags/ /gang dag chos lam brtson pas sgrub rnams kyang*/ /bar chad bdud kyis bslus pa grangs mang zhing*/ /bzang po'i las las nyams pa'i tshul mthong nas/ /brtson 'grus rang bzhin skye bar dka' ba lags/ /mdor na chos dang 'jig rten thams cad la/ /brtson kyang mtha' med bzhag kyang rang bab zhig /'bad kyang ngal ba don med tshul mthong nas/ /brtson 'grus rang bzhin skye bar dka' ba lags/ /zhes brjod pa na/ don de nyes par 'gro ba'i glang po 'dul dka' bas/ dge ba'i phyogs kyi bar chad du 'gyur ba las ldog pa'i phyir/ /ri bong gi mchog des smras pa/ dpal ldan mtho ris grong gi skye rgu'i nang*/ /yon tan gdugs dkar gcig mdzes phun tshogs gang*/ /sngon nas legs par 'bad pa'i 'bras yin pas/ /rtag tu legs pa'i brtson 'grus bsngags pa nyon/ /brtson 'grus mngon mtho nges legs chos kun gyi/

/gzhi dang rtsa ba byed pa'i rkyen yin zhing*/ /don rnams sgrub pa'i bzhon pa mchog yin pas/ /rtag tu legs pa'i brtson 'grus bsten par mdzod/ /'dod pa'i don rnams phun tshogs yod pa dang*/ /'bad pa'i shugs kyis mngon sum grub mthong bas/ /thug mtha' mchis la zin pa yod pas na/ /rtag tu legs pa'i brtson 'grus bsten par mdzod/ /legs par brtson la nyes pa'i shas mi srid/ /rmongs pas 'bad pa don rnams 'dzol ba gang*/ /rgyu 'bras zab mo'i rten 'brel mkhyen mdzod la/ /rtag tu legs pa'i brtson 'grus bsten par mdzod/ /bya ba gang la brtson pa'i skyon chags pa/ /legs par ma shes 'bad las gyur pas na/ /dang por skyon yon dus skabs rig mdzod la/ /rtag tu legs pa'i brtson 'grus bsten par mdzod/ /le lo can la legs pa nam yang med/ /gang zhig legs mthong de yang 'bad pa'i shugs/ /sngon gyi brtson pas bskyed pa'i 'bras bu tsam/ /rtag tu legs pa'i brtson 'grus bsten par mdzod/ /brtson dang mi brtson 'tsho gos phyid pa yang*/ /sngon las brtson pa'i shugs te 'di nyid na/ /brtson pa lhod rnams dbul zhing phongs pa mang*/ /rtag tu legs pa'i brtson 'grus bsten par mdzod/ /chos mchog sgrub la rtag tu brtson 'tshal te/ /lus ngag sems la mi dal 'bad pa gces/ /mi brtson le los nam yang don mi 'grub/ /rtag tu legs pa'i brtson 'grus bsten par mdzod/ /bsam gtan spyad la dal bar mngon rnams kyang*/ /skad cig mi yengs sems la brtson byed pas/ /lus ngag 'bad pa brgyar 'gyur char mi phod/ /rtag tu legs pa'i brtson 'grus bsten par mdzod/ /gang zhig goms na sla bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /gnas de gang na'ang yod pa ma yin pas/ /le lo spangs nas gnyen po 'bad pa'i shugs/ /rtag tu legs pa'i brtson 'grus bsten par mdzod/ /tha mal bya byed bzhag na spong 'gyur la/ /sems kyis btang na dga' ba'i zhen pa spang*/

/chos kyang bags kyis sgrub na dka' ba med/ /rtag tu legs pa'i brtson 'grus bsten par mdzod/ /lus ngag sems dal sgyid lug goms pas te/ /bags kyis brtson na ldog par dka' ba med/ /goms rjes byed pa kun gyi chos nyid yin/ /rtag tu legs pa'i brtson 'grus bsten par mdzod/ /sgrib kun glo bur yin phyir spang sla la/ /yon tan lhun gyis grub phyir rang la yod/ /sgyid lug zhum pa'i sems ni rab spongs la/ /rtag tu legs pa'i brtson 'grus bsten par mdzod/ /gang zhig chos las nyams pa de dag kyang*/ /nam zhig thar ba dam pa thob 'gyur te/ /rgyu 'bras rang bzhin bslu ba med de'i phyir/ /rtag tu legs pa'i brtson 'grus bsten par mdzod/ /mdor na chos dang 'jig rten phun tshogs kun/ /gang la brtson pa mchog des 'grub 'gyur zhing*//mi brtson pa ni de las ldog pa'i phyir/ /rtag tu legs pa'i brtson 'grus bsten par mdzod/ /ces brjod pas/ le lo ngan pa'i tshul spangs te/ brtson 'grus dam pa sgrub pa la rab tu spro bar gyur to/ /de nas yang rab tu byung ba des bsam pa/brtson 'grus ni yon tan bzang po'i rjes su 'gro bas sgrub par nus kyi/ thos pa ni mchog tu bya dka' bas btang snyoms su bzhag go snyam nas smras pa/ legs pa'i chu gter shin tu rmad byung ba/ /mkhyen rab yon tan me tog mdangs bkra zhing*/ /dul ba'i rdzing bur ri bong 'dzin gzugs can/ /thos pa'i rang bzhin bsten par dka' bas gson/ /sna tshogs shes bya'i gnas kyang rgya che la/ /tshig don rtogs dka'i rnam pa grangs mang zhing*/ /ji tsam 'bad kyang thams cad shes mi nus/ /thos pa'i rang bzhin bsten par dka' ba lags/ /shes par rlom pa kun kyang mi 'cham la/ /yin min rtsod pa'i gnas la zhi dus med/ /mtha' gcig nges pa'i rang bzhin med pa 'dra/ /thos pa'i rang bzhin bsten par dka' ba lags/ /sgom par zhugs pa kun kyang mi 'cham la/

/nyams len so so'i gnas la kha 'dzin che/ /chos bdag 'dzin pa ba thag 'dzings pa 'dra/ /thos pa'i rang bzhin bsten par dka' ba lags/ /mkhas par khas 'che 'chad rtsod rtsom rnams kyang*/ /nga mkhas mi 'cham nga rgyal me dpung 'bar/ /tha snyad chos kyang snying po med pa 'dra/ /thos pa'i rang bzhin bsten par dka' ba lags/ /sgrub par khas 'che sgom par zhugs rnams kyang*/ /nga bzang mi 'cham chos brgyad ma bral bas/ /don gyis thos kyang the tshom za ba 'dra/ /thos pa'i rang bzhin bsten par dka' ba lags/ /gnas lugs don la 'di yin kha mi 'cham/ /so so'i phyogs ris yid dpyod grub mtha' rtsod/ /gzhi yi chos la'ang nges pa med pa 'dra/ /thos pa'i rang bzhin bsten par dka' ba lags/ /nyams len gnas la'ang thams cad kha mi 'cham/ /byed lugs thams cad 'gal 'du'i tshul mang bas/ /lam gyi chos la'ang nges pa med pa 'dra/ /thos pa'i rang bzhin bsten par dka' ba lags/ /chos sku'i gnas la yin lugs kha mi 'cham/ /ye shes yod med sgro skur shin tu mang*/ /'bras bu'i chos kyang nges pa med pa 'dra/ /thos pa'i rang bzhin bsten par dka' ba lags/ /mdor na deng sang mthun pa gcig kyang med/ /thams cad mi mthun so so'i gnas la bsten/ /gang yin mi shes 'di yin ma nges pa'i/ /thos pa'i rang bzhin bsten par dka' ba lags/ /zhes brjod pa na/ don de mchog tu ngo mtshar mi che bas/ dman par 'jug pa'i lam las ldog pa'i phyir/ ri bong gi mchog des smras pa/ gang zhig rnam bkra shes bya'i skyed tshal du/ /blo gros rnam dpyod 'od stong shar gyur pas/ /skal bzang blo mig padmo rgyas pa yi/ /thos pa'i yon tan bsngags pa bshad kyis nyon/ /thos pa 'dod 'byung lha yi dpag bsam shing*/ /gang la ci 'dod re ba rdzogs byed pa'i/ /phun tshogs sgrub pa de dang mtshungs yod min/ /yang dag thos pa'i don la bsten par mdzod/ /thos pas don rnams rig cing nor ba spang*/

/legs kun sgrub la yon tan 'byor ba 'dzin/ /dam pa rnams kyi lam bzang shing rta che/ /yang dag thos pa'i don la bsten par mdzod/ /shes bya'i gnas dang rnam grangs rgya che yang*/ /bgrod pa'i lam la rgyu 'bras theg par 'dus/ /gang mos der zhugs thos pas sgro 'dogs gcod/ /yang dag thos pa'i don la bsten par mdzod/ /don gcig gnas de thos pa kun gyi dgra/ /nye bar 'jug pa sman gyi sde tshan bzhin/ /chos kun thos pas gdams la zhum mi 'tshal/ /yang dag thos pa'i don la bsten par mdzod/ /nad kyi gnyen po sman rnams mtha' yas kyang*/ /skabs kyi dbang gis gcig la kun brjod ltar/ /gang 'dod lam gyi cha rkyen de bzhin las/ /yang dag thos pa'i don la bsten par mdzod/ /mkhas rnams tshig don gnas la rtsod na yang*/ /rang gzhan grub mtha' gong 'og gtan 'bebs tsam/ /thar lam gnas la blang dor kun mthun pas/ /yang dag thos pa'i don la bsten par mdzod/ /tha snyad rtsod rnams nges pa med 'dra yang*/ /so so'i sa lam nyams len nges par yod/ /tshogs gnyis lam las byang chub sgrub don gcig /yang dag thos pa'i don la bsten par mdzod/ /sgom sgrub tshul la rim pa grangs mang yang*/ /yin tshul 'gags la gzung 'dzin nyon mongs spang*/ /sems nyid ngang la ma yengs don mthun pas/ /yang dag thos pa'i don la bsten par mdzod/ /mkhas pa'i nga rgyal gtan tshigs khong nas shar/ /khengs par snang yang rang bzhin dul pas na/ /chos kyi mchod sdong nam yang dmad mi bya/ /yang dag thos pa'i don la bsten par mdzod/ /bsam gtan spyod rnams rab tu drang bas na/ /sems la gang shar ngag tu brjod nas yal/ /de la gzhan zhig log rtog skye mi rung*/ /yang dag thos pa'i don la bsten par mdzod/ /gang zhig bkru tshe dri ma rnam mang ba/ /dri ma bslangs nas myur du dag pa bzhin/ /tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i skyes bu de dang 'dra/ /yang dag thos pa'i don la bsten par mdzod/
