/sgrub par zhugs rnams bzang por bzhed pa mchog /don gnyis sgrub tshe thabs dang 'phrul dgos pas/ /'jig rten chos brgyad gshe ba mi btang 'tshal/ /yang dag thos pa'i don la bsten par mdzod/ /rang rang lam la bstod pa yid ches gzhi/ /tha dad gnas la bsten pa chos kyi sgo/ /cung zad 'gal 'dur snang ba che chung khyad/ /yang dag thos pa'i don la bsten par mdzod/ /don dam dbyings la su yis ci brjod kyang*/ /bdag med spros bral nam mkha' lta bur mthun/ /gnas lugs gzhi la the tshom bskyed mi bya/ /yang dag thos pa'i don la bsten par mdzod/ /'jug pa'i lam la rnams grangs mtha' yas kyang*/ /thabs shes zung 'jug nyams len mi 'gal mthun/ /rgyu 'bras gnas la 'gal 'du'i the tshom dor/ /yang dag thos pa'i don la bsten par mdzod/ /mthar thug chos sku'i 'dod tshul grangs mang yang*/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin sku gnyis thob par mthun/ /'bras bu'i gnas la sgro skur mthar 'dzin pas/ /yang dag thos pa'i don la bsten par mdzod/ /deng sang chos rnams tha dad grangs mang yang*/ /chos kyi sgo dang theg pa'i rnam grangs yin/ /yin min dbye bsal chos spong las mi gsog /yang dag thos pa'i don la bsten par mdzod/ /e ma thos pa ngo mtshar mchog tu 'phags/ /gang zhig yod pas 'jig rten chos rnams dang*/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i chos rnams phun tshogs sgrub/ /thos pa yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas lags//gang zhig che rgus bsten pa'i skye bo yang*/ /blang dor shes pas skye rgu skyong ba na/ /sngon gyi lam bzang thos pa'i rjes 'gro bas/ /thos pa yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas lags/ /yul 'khor so so'i chab srid so nam dang*/ /legs rgu'i 'dun gros bzang po sgrub pa yang*/ /sngon gyi lam bzang thos pa'i rjes 'gro bas/ /thos pa yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas lags/ /kun gyi rgyan gyur legs pa'i bzo rigs dang*/ /gzhan phan rigs pa sman la sogs pa yang*/

/sngon gyi lam bzang thos pa'i rjes 'gro bas/ /thos pa yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas lags/ /dpa' bo thabs mkhas dgra sde gzhom pa dang*/ /bud med mdzangs ma bu nor spel ba yang*/ /sngon gyi lam bzang thos pa'i rjes 'gro bas/ /thos pa yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas lags/ /bran rnams las byed zho shas 'tsho ba dang*/ /slong mo spyod lam bza' btung gnyer ba'i bar/ /sngon gya lam bzang thos pa'i rjes 'gro bas/ /thos pa yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas lags/ /'jig rten 'das pa zhi ba gnyer rnams kyang*/ /blang dor shes pas legs pa'i lam bsten nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub la rab 'jug pas/ /thos pa yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas lags/ /thos pas kun shes blo gros mun pa sel/ /gzhan la 'doms nus legs pa'i 'od stong 'phro/ /nyes kun skyob la rtag tu bkra shis pa/ /thos pa yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas lags/ /theg gsum nges par 'byung ba'i skye bo yang*/ /thos pas rang rang gnas de rig 'gyur zhing*/ /gnas skabs mthar thug legs pa kun 'grub pas/ /thos pa yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas lags/ /rgyal sras lam bzang sa rnams bgrod pa yang*/ /chos kyi sgo dang theg pa'i don thos nas/ /ting 'dzin 'bum phrag yangs pa'i lam la 'jug /thos pa yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas lags/ /rgyal ba rnams 'dren phan par mdzad de yang*/ /skye rgu 'dul zhing kha lo sgyur ba na/ /sngon gyi smon lam thos pa'i rjes 'gro bas/ /thos pa yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas lags/ /theg pa gang la gsar du zhugs rnams kyang*/ /yang dag thos pa dam pa'i rjes 'gro la/ /gzhan rnams kun kyang mtshungs par 'jug de'i phyir/ /thos pa yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas lags/ /thos pa mkha' bzhin dri med rgya che la/ /ri bzhin brtan cing sa bzhin kun gyi rten/ /mtsho bzhin dwangs la 'dod 'byung yid bzhin gnas/ /dam pa rnams kyi gnas la bsten par mdzod/

/thos pa skyabs kyi mchog ste nyes kun skyob/ /mgon med srid par 'khor ba'i rgud pa sel/ /'jigs las dbugs 'byin sdug bsngal chu bo spong*/ /dam pa rnams kyi gnas la bsten par mdzod/ /thos pa gnas rnams nang nas bla na med/ /dam chos rin chen khang bzang dam par spyod/ /zab cing rgya che'i tshig don dam pas mdzes/ /dam pa rnams kyi gnas la bsten par mdzod/ /thos pa rgyan rnams nang nas mdzes pa'i mchog /dam par mtshon zhing kun gyis snyan par smra/ /lha rnams kyis kyang bstod par bya ba'i 'os/ /dam pa rnams kyi gnas la bsten par mdzod/ /thos pa nor rnams nang nas 'phags pa'i nor/ /rkun po rnams dang rgyal pos mi 'phrog cing*/ /rtag tu rang dbang 'byor pas phun sum tshogs/ /dam pa rnams kyi gnas la bsten par mdzod/ /thos pa mig rnams nang nas blo gros mig /snang dang mi snang gzugs rnams blta nus shing*/ /rags pas mi sgrib gang la'ang thogs pa med/ /dam pa rnams kyi gnas la bsten par mdzod/ /thos pa don rnams nang nas legs pa'i don/ /'dod rgur bsgyur zhing ci bsam re ba skong*/ /lha rdzas rin chen mchog las bkra shis 'phel/ /dam pa rnams kyi gnas la bsten par mdzod/ /mdor na chos dang 'jig rten thams cad la/ /yang dag thos pa dam pa rab gces pas/ /'di dang phyi ma'i legs pa sgrub rnams kyis/ /don rnams 'byor slad thos pa bsten par mdzod/ /ces brjod pas/rmongs par dga' ba'i mun bsal nas/ thos pa sgrub pa la spro bar gyur to/ /de nas yang rab tu byung ba des bsam pa/ /thos pa rin po che'i mdzod khang ni bsten pa legs kyi/ bsam gtan ni mchog tu bya dka' bas sgrub par mi nus so snyam nas smras pa/ mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin thugs rje'i gzhu drag las/ /dam chos rin chen tshangs dbyangs mda' 'phangs pas/ /gdul bya'i log rtog dpung 'joms ri bong mchog /bsam gtan rang bzhin sgrub par dka' bas gson/

/mchog tu nye bar zhi ba bya dka' la/ /ma yengs don la gnas pa sems kyi khur/ /ting 'dzin mnyam par 'jog pa goms dka' bas/ /bsam gtan sgom par zhugs pa mchog tu dka'/ /bsgrub bya'i bsam gtan de yang grangs mang la/ /'di yin mi 'cham gang zab ngo mi shes/ /thabs tshul mang yang thog tu phebs pa dkon/ /bsam gtan sgom par zhugs pa mchog tu dka'/ /tshe 'di spangs nas sgrub par chas na yang*/ /skye bo kun gyis de la zhad re 'dogs/ /don med smra brjod du mas sdig sog pas/ /bsam gtan sgom par zhugs pa mchog tu dka'/ /cung zad bzung na 'dod pa che zhes smra/ /drang por brjod na 'grogs par dka' zhes gshe/ /kha rog bsdad na blun no rmongs zhes sgrogs/ /bsam gtan sgom par zhugs pa mchog tu dka'/ /ri ngogs bsten yang yon tan ma skyes la/ /dben par gnas kyang bya byed su bas mang*/ /bzod sran chung la 'dod pa cher mthong nas/ /bsam gtan sgom par zhugs pa mchog tu dka'/ /ji tsam bsgoms kyang grub pa'i rtags med la/ /grol ba'i tshad med yon tan mthong tshor med/ /bsgoms dang ma bsgoms 'dra ba'i tshul mthong nas/ /bsam gtan sgom par zhugs pa mchog tu dka'/ /mdor na gnas lugs zhi ba'i bsam gtan dang*/ /sgom par zhugs pa'i gang zag bya dka' la/ /'gal 'du'i gnas kyang mang bas the tshom gzhi/ /bsam gtan sgom par zhugs pa mchog tu dka'/ /zhes brjod pa na/ /don de nyid log par rtog pa rngam po cher gyur pa las ldog pa'i phyir/ ri bong gi mchog des smras pa/ gang zhig bsgoms pas srid mtsho mthar 'byin zhing*/ /thar pa dam pa zhi ba'i gling bgrod pa/ /bsam gtan gru chen gnas la bsten pa yi/ /yon tan me tog phreng ba rgyun chags nyon/ /zhi ba'i de nyid mchog tu bya dka' yang*/ /zab mo'i thabs kyis rnyed par dka' ba med/ /ma yengs ting 'dzin sgom pa'i rjes 'gro bas/ /zab don snying po'i bsam gtan sgom par mdzod/

/rgyu 'bras lam la rnam pa grangs mang yang*/ /so so'i zab lam snying por brtson byas na/ /de dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu 'grub par nges/ /zab don snying po'i bsam gtan sgom par mdzod/ /dam pa rnams dang rang sems dpang btsugs nas/ /zhi ba gnyer la nyes pa 'ga' med pas/ /kun gyis dmad kyang de la 'jigs mi dgos/ /zab don snying po'i bsam gtan sgom par mdzod/ /chog shes ldan pas mthun rkyen gzung pa la/ /gzhan gyis dmad kyang dam chos sgrub pa'i grogs/ /chos dang rjes su mthun pas 'gyod pa med/ /zab don snying po'i bsam gtan sgom par mdzod/ /sgo gsum bsdams nas rang sems g.yo med pas/ /drang zhing gsong por smra la mi dad cing*/ /rjes su khro ba skye ba blun po yin/ /zab don snying po'i bsam gtan sgom par mdzod/ /deng sang 'bras bu'i dus las yol bas na/ /sngon bzhin cung zad sgom pas rtags mthong min/ /sgrub pa yun du bsrings na gal gyi mthong*/ /zab don snying po'i bsam gtan sgom par mdzod/ /gzhan dang bsten 'dris spangs pas spro thung la/ /chos phyir dka' ba spyod pa'i gzugs ngan yang*/ /'jig rten 'khrul pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pas/ /zab don snying po'i bsam gtan sgom par mdzod/ /bsam gtan dag dang gang la spyod pa yi/ /gang zag mchog tu dka' bas dam par mtshon/ /gnas gzhan the tshom rmongs pa'i ngan rtog yin/ /zab don snying po'i bsam gtan sgom par mdzod/ /gnas lugs bsgoms pas rig pa'i don mthong na/ /thun mong drod rtags mthong pa med kyang bla/ /rig stong chos sku mtshan ma med pa lags/ /zab don snying po'i bsam gtan sgom par mdzod/ /gzhan yang dang por sgrub la zhugs pa'i tshe/ /drod rtags ched du 'bad pa ma yin la/ /thob par gyur kyang ston pa'i khyad yod dam/ /zab don snying po'i bsam gtan sgom par mdzod/ /gshis kyi drod rtags gzung 'dzin mkha' ltar dag /thog tu phebs pa rtogs pa'i gdeng tshad yin/

/de nyid rang gi zab mo sems kyi yul/ /zab don snying po'i bsam gtan sgom par mdzod/ /bsam gtan sgom pa dag pa'i drod tshad ni/ /sems la dbang thob mngon shes rdzu 'phrul te/ /tshu rol mthong bas de nyid bltar mi nus/ /zab don snying po'i bsam gtan sgom par mdzod/ /grub chen rnams ni dgongs pa'i khyad kyis ston/ /deng sang bstan kyang sgro skur sgrib pa gsog /rnal 'byor grub pa kun la snang nges med/ /zab don snying po'i bsam gtan sgom par mdzod/ /rang gis mthong bas gzhan la dpag byas nas/ /deng sang dam pa rnams la sdig ma gsog /sbas pa'i grub chen gang yin shes pa med/ /zab don snying po'i bsam gtan sgom par mdzod/ /'jig rten 'di na sngon med ngo mtshar cig /sgom la zhugs nas ci yang mi dgos la/ /tshor ba med par bems por gnas 'gyur dgos/ /rigs sam sems la de nyid dpyad par mdzod/ /sgo gsum rang la skyon gyi dngos por rtog /rang dang mi mthun log ltas tshar gcod la/ /zhi ba gnyer la dman pa'i bzhad gad gnas/ /rigs sam sems la de nyid dpyad par mdzod/ /tshe yang yun thang skad cig re res 'grib/ myur du 'chi yang don med 'khrul phyir 'brang*/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor thob kyang don med byed/ /rigs sam sems la de nyid dpyad par mdzod/ /kye ma grogs dag 'chi bdag myur du 'ong*/ /da res 'chi med bdud rtsi'i don bsgoms te/ /skye 'chi med pa'i g.yung drung 'thob bya'i phyir/ /zab mo'i don gyi bsam gtan bsten par mdzod/ /mtho ris lus rnyed dge ba'i srog shing las/ /bsod nams 'khor lo yon tan yangs mig can/ /dad dang brtson pa'i bzhon pas rang bskyod de/ /dal 'byor shing rta chos la drang bar mdzod/ /sngon las legs smon dag pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /dam chos dge bar spyod pa'i yul skyes shing*/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i lam mkhan yod dus 'dir/ /gtan du legs pa'i bsam gtan bsten par mdzod/

/ji ltar chu ni mthong dang thos pa yis/ /skaum pa'i gdung ba sel bar mi nus ltar//ma bsgoms chos kyang rang bzhin de dang 'dra/ /gdung sel zhi ba'i bsam gtan bsten par mdzod/ /ji ltar lam rnams yid kyis rnam brtags shing*/ /tshig gis gzhal kyang phyin par mi nus ltar/ /ma bsgoms chos kyang rang bzhin de dang 'dra/ /thar lam myur bgrod bsam gtan bsten par mdzod/ /chos 'dir rtag tu goms par ma byas na/ /chos nyid zhi ba'i don de mi mthong bas/ /don dam dbyings de mthong par bgyi slad du/ /zab mo'i bsam gtan rtag tu bsten par mdzod/ /da res gtan gyi legs pa ma 'grub na/ /yang 'khor yang 'khrul srid pa'i 'khor lor 'khyams/ /mtha' med sdug bsngal bzod par mi nus pas/ /skye shi med pa'i bsam gtan bsten par mdzod/ /mdor na ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal ba dang*/ /rgyal sras dam pas ji ltar bsgoms pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang rang bzhin de la tshad btsugs te/ /chos kun snying po zab mo'i bsam gtan mdzod/ /ces brjod pas/ zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin sgom pa la spro bar gyur to/ /de nas yang rab tu byung ba des bsam pa/ zab mo'i don la sgom pa'i bsam gtan snying po'i de kho na nyid sgrub pa legs mod kyi/ dben pa ni mchog tu bya dka' bas mi nus so snyam nas smras pa/ thugs rje'i brtse sprin rin chen snying po las/ /bdud rtsi'i chos char bsil ba'i rgyun babs pas/ /nyon mongs gdung sel dam pa'i ri bong mchog /dben pa'i gnas la bsten par dka' bas gson/ /gangs khrod nags dang bas mtha'i gnas mal dang*/ /gling dang brag ri lung stong ri ngogs sogs/ /mi med dben pa gang de skyon mang bas/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /skye bos spangs pas mthun pa'i zla med la/ /nyin mo skyo zhing mtshan mo 'jigs pa ste/ /mi bzad 'byung pos bsten pas srog la rgol/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/

/gnas der dus min sgra dang sa g.yo la/ /'byung ba'i skad dang brag ri snyil la sogs/ /gnyan zhing 'jigs su rung bas ltas mang bas/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /mi rgod 'dre dang spyang ki 'phar ba dang*/ /dom dred stag dang gzig la sogs pa yi/ /gcan gzan ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs mang bas/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /tshe 'di'i zas nor skye bo kun spangs nas/ /de 'dra'i gnas su gang zhig su gnas pa/ /rgyal po'i chad pas spyugs pa'i mi 'dra bas/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /gnas der bde sdug rkyen yang grangs mang la/ /gegs shig byung na su la'ang 'dri sa med/ /na yang g.yog med shi yang mi tshor bas/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /grogs dang bcas pa'i ri ngogs dben pa yang*/ /sa khad mtho bas babs kyis chu ngan la/ /'grul 'grim dka' zhing 'gro 'dug sdug bsngal mang*/ /thar ba 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /mang po 'tshogs na gcig gis gcig g.yengs la/ /dben pa'i don med grong 'dabs sde dgon bzhin/ /nyung ngur gnas na dgra rkun mi thub pas/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /dben pa de yang gzhan las sems skyo na/ /stan la mi tshugs 'gro dad gtam la dga'/ /rnam rtog mi non don med bya byed mang*/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /tshe 'di'i don dang thos bsam kun bzhag nas/ /sgrub la zhugs kyang grub pa'i rtags med la/ /snying po yod pa'i mdo don gcig kyang med/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /bya byed spangs na mthun rkyen mi 'byor la/ /brel do byas na dben pa'i tshul dang 'gal/ /chos bzhin spyad kyang rtag tu khas nyen pas/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /dben par gnas rnams gzhan las 'grogs dka' la/ /'du shes blun cing rnam rtog su bas rags/ /gleng brjod mang la nang rigs mi gshin pas/

/thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /dben pa'i mi rnams bud med tshogs dang 'dra/ /re zhig mthong tshe mthun zhing dul dul 'dra/ /rang bzhin khro dang phrag dog zug rngu che/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /dben pa zer yang blun rmongs dud 'gro'i gnas/ /rmongs pa 'du zhing rmongs pa'i tshogs kyis bsten/ /rmongs la rmongs 'du rmongs pa rgyun mi 'chad/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /dben pa zer yang blo mig 'grib pa'i gnas/ /sngar shes brjed la gsar du gti mug skye/ /shes byas phongs shing thos bsam snang ba bral/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /dben pa zer yang sos dal sgyid lug gnas/ /chos dang 'jig rten dka' ba ma bzod kun/ /sgom la snyad btags snyom las ci bder nyal/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /dben pa zer ba bag yangs rang ga'i gnas/ /sha chang sgog tsong dus min zas rnams kun/ /nam dran longs spyod ngo tsha sba gsang bral/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /dben pa zer yang ma bskyed byis pa'i gnas/ /sde tshan bral zhing kha tas 'jun mkhan med/ /gu yangs spyod pa 'di bya'i tshad las 'das/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /dben pa zer yang bag med smyon pa'i gnas/ /mi yis chang 'thung chang gis mi 'thung bas/ /ngag 'khyal glu gzhas tho co skyur 'gong skye/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /dben pa zer yang 'du shes chung ba'i gnas/ /tshig tsam mi bzod khro dang zug rngu 'phel/ /legs nyes tshe na gzhan las sems 'khos chung*/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /dben pa zer yang yul rkyen ngan pa'i gnas/ /bag med chang dang mi mthun mtshan mang pas/ /gnyen po chung rnams tshangs spyod nyams pa'i rgyu/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /dben pa zer yang mi mdzes sbed pa'i gnas/ /gzhan du skyon chags kun gyis spangs ba dang*/

/dbang po ma tshang rnams kyis nyer bsten pas/ /thar pa 'dod kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /mdor na deng sang dben pa'i ri ngogs na/ /mthun pa'i rkyen nyung 'gal ba'i rkyen mang bas/ /ri dwags gzugs can rnams kyi gnas de la/ /thar 'dod rnams kyang bsten par dka' ba lags/ /zhes brjod pa na/ don de nyid phyin ci log gi mun pa mi bzad pas bsgribs pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i gnas la dmod pa nyes pa khur lci bas/ tshul de las ldog par 'dod nas/ ri bong gi mchog des smras pa/ thugs rje'i gdugs dkar yangs pa'i mchog gcig gis/ /srid gsum 'gro ba nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par/ /ma lus yongs bkod drang srong mchog rnams kyis/ /rtag tu nyer bsten dben pa'i bsngags pa nyon/ /thub pa drang srong mchog rnams bzhugs bzhugs pa/ /skye bo dam pa rnams kyis bsten bsten pa/ /yon tan rang bzhin can rnams dgyes dgyes pa/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis rtag tu bsngags bsngags pa/ /nags tshal dben pa zhi ba'i gnas dag la/ /log par rtog pa'i mun pa kun bsal nas/ /chos dkar yon tan snang ba mched bya'i phyir/ /dben pa bsten par gdams la spro bar mdzod/ /'jig rten skye bos mchog tu dben pa gang*/ /yongs su sbyangs pa rnams kyi gnas lags pas/ /drod rtags ldan pa gang rnams bsten pa lags/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /skye bo med pas mchog tu chos 'phel zhing*/ /'byung po mang bas brtul zhugs yon tan 'grub/ /mchog tu gnyan pas rtogs pa bogs 'byin pas/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /drod ldan rnal 'byor nam yang skyo ba med/ /chos mchog zhi ba'i bdud rtsir rab dga' la/ /gcan gzan gtum po rnams kyang zil gyis gnon/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /gzhan yang dga' 'jigs sems kyi khyad par te/ /byis pa dben par 'jigs la grong la dga'/ /ri dwags grong du 'jigs la dben par dga'/

/log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /phal pa rnams ni 'du 'dzi'i gnas dga' la/ /bar ma rnams ni cung zad dben la dga'/ /dam pa mchog rnams rab tu dben par dgyes/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba thams cad nam yang 'dor/ /de bas dam chos spyod pa mchog gzigs la/ /dam pa rnams ni dben par dgyes pa lags/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /gzhan la ltos pa med rnams ci byung yang*/ /dbang sgyur rig pa'i grogs te rtogs pa'i klong*/ /na shi rkyen dbang chos nyid rig pa'i rgyan/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /gang na grogs dang bcas pas dben pa gang*/ /'du 'dzi'i gnas rnams kun las ches lhag ste/ /ngang gis chos 'phel bya ba nyung ba lags/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /chu ni khams kyi rjes su byed pa ste/ /phyogs gcig bzang ba mtho dman gang la'ang med/ /gcig la 'phrod de gcig la gnod pa mang*/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /gyen mthur 'gro 'dug lus spyod zas rnams 'ju/ /nad rnams sbyong zhing lus sems spyod pa mang*/ /de la sogs pa'i yon tan grangs mang bas/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /dad ldan mang na dad pa'i rlabs che bas/ /chos dang zang zing legs pa'i tshogs rnams 'phel/ /mig rkyen mang na spang blang don la mkhas/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /dgra dang chom rkun sngon gyi lan chags te/ /las yod rnams la gang du'ang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /med na gcig pur gnas kyang byung dogs med/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /dben par skye 'jigs gtam dang bya byed kun/ /chos la ma brtson rang gar shor bas te/ /dbang po dul la snang ba chos su bsgyur/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /bya byed spangs nas bsgrubs kyang rtags med na/

/brtson pas ma 'bad ngang thung res 'jog skyon/ /zab mo'i gnas la yun du bsring ba gces/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /gang gis bskal pa bye bar thos pa bas/ /zab mo'i don la skad cig gnas pa mchog /ting 'dzin rgyal por gsungs bzhin don chen ldan/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /rigs pa'i don rnams gang yin bstun dgos la/ /dma' ba'i sa rnams 'dzin pa dam pa'i lugs/ /de la dmod pa gzhan gyi phrag dog yin/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /dben par gnas na g.yo sgyu'i tha ba spang*/ /drang por spyod na 'jig rten tshul dang 'gal/ /skyon du rtog pa ngan pa'i rang skyon yin/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /dben par gnas pa gang la skyon mthong ba/ /de kun gang zag rang gi nor ba'i skyon/ /gnas la dmod pa skye bo ngan pa'i lugs/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /dben par rmongs na mkhas rnams bsten pa'i tshe/ /de yang rmongs 'gyur dben pa bsten pa'i phyir/ /gnas gzhan rnams na rmongs pa med par rigs/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /gang la skyon chags gnas kyi skyon yin na/ /dben pa bas kyang gzhan rnams skyon mang bas/ /gnas gzhan rnams la lhag par dmad par rigs/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /gang la skyon chags 'du 'dzi'i gnas rnams la/ /nye bar bsten zhing skyon med gnas la dmod/ /'di 'dra deng sang bdud kyis zin pa lags/ /log rtog spongs la dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /kye ma grogs dag dben pa'i yon tan nyon/ /'du 'dzi'i grong dang rab tu rgyang ring pas/ /mi srun skye bo rnams kyi 'jigs pa med/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /byis pa nye bar ma zhi nyon mongs can/ /tshe 'di'i 'khrul pas gzings pa de dag dang*/ /lhan cig gnas pa'i nyes pa mtha' yas pas/

/yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /skye bo rang gi 'dod pa'i rjes su byed/ /de dang bstun na rtag tu nyon mongs 'phel/ /dal 'byor don med rnam par g.yengs pas na/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /phyi nang skye bo gang dang gang yang rung*/ /yun du bsten na byas pa mi gzo la/ /khro dang 'thab rtsod nyes pa cis kyang 'byung*/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /phan pas 'bad kyang rtag tu re che la/ /mi snyan kha zer nam yang mgu dus med/ /ngal ba 'bras bu chung ba'i gnas spangs la/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /nyin mtshan 'khrul pa'i las la zin dus med/ /don med skye bo'i sems la mgu dus med/ /rnam g.yengs 'du 'dzi'i gnas la zad dus med/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /sngon gyi rgyal bas zhi ba brnyes pa yang*/ /dben pa'i gnas su bsten par mdzad las byung*/ /dam pa rnams kyi rjes su 'gro 'dod pas/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /dben pa'i gnas na dul ba'i ri dwags dang*/ /zhi ba'i bya tshogs mang pos gar byed cing*/ /ri rtser nags kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /gangs ri'i phreng bas bskor ba'i ra ba dang*/ /brag ri'i mgur chu sman ljongs mdangs bkra zhing*/ /nags tshal lha yi skyed mos ches lhag pa'i/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /ljon pa'i shing rnams g.yo ba'i gar byed cing*/ /me tog phreng ba'i lag rtsed dud pa ni/ /'ongs pa legs zhes mgron la bsu ba bzhin/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /ge sar 'dab rgyas rkang drug myos pa'i tshal/ /'dzum pa bzhin gyi ze'u 'bru gsal ba ni/ /yid 'ong lha yi bu mo lhags pa bzhin/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /chu rnams lbu ba'i seng khrol dang bcas pas/

/gya gyur rgyug cing lhung sgra snyan sgrogs pas/ /gar ldan skye bos bstod dbyangs len pa bzhin/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /la la 'khyil zhing mi g.yo dwangs pa ni/ /sems dang sems byung rnyog pa rab zhi nas/ /chos nyid ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa bzhin/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /sus kyang ma byas brag ri'i khang bzang dang*/ /rdo leb khri mchog rab tu bzang po la/ /nyi 'od 'jam dro mal stegs bkod pa bzhin/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /ri dwags rtsed 'jo bung ba'i glu gar dang*/ /gnyis skyes sgra snyan mchog tu mdzes pa ni/ /lha yi skyed tshal rang bzhin 'phos pa bzhin/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /sos ka dbyar dang ston dus dgun dang dpyid/ /rim gyis 'gyur bas mi rtag skyo shas 'phel/ /ting 'dzin bsten pa'i rang bzhin phun sum tshogs/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /dus bzhir dben zhing ngang gis chos 'phel bas/ /'khrul dang ca co rtsod kun nyer zhi la/ /tshe gang don yod dal 'byor snying por byed/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /'jig rten mtshan ma dag las rab 'das pas/ /skye bo ma bsdams pa rnams sdom 'gyur la/ /bsdams pa rnams ni zhi ba'i mchog rab 'phel/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /shing rnams yal ga lo ma lhags pa dang*/ /tshal rnams me tog 'dab ma rnyings mthong nas/ /ring bor mi thogs 'chi ba dran par byed/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /chu rnams g.yo ba gya gyur 'bab pa dang*/ /sprin rnams 'gyur bas gzhan du 'gro mthong nas/ /tshe srog mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byed/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor nub tu bsnyegs pa dang*/ /ri bo'i grib ma shar du phyogs mthong nas/ /skad cig mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byed/

/yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /nub ka'i bya rnams shing la bsnyegs pa dang*/ /ri dwags rang gi gnas la 'gro mthong nas/ /skyes pa'i tha ma 'chi ba dran par byed/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /padmo rnams ni rdzing bur gnas pa dang*/ /bung ba rnams ni tshang du gnas mthong nas/ /bsam gtan pa rnams gnas lugs dran par byed/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /ri bo rnams ni mchog tu brtan pa dang*/ /dri med nam mkha' rnam par dag mthong nas/ /'pho 'gyur med pa'i chos dbyings dran par byed/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /mdor na deng sang dam chos ma bsgrubs na/ /gang dang cis kyang rang bzhin phan pa med/ /'gyur zhing mi brtan snying po 'ga' med pas/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /skyes pa 'chi zhing 'dus pa'i tshogs 'bral la/ /bsags pa 'dzad cing mthon po'i mtha' rgud pas/ /'khor ba'i chos la nam yang yid brtan med/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /gang zhig thob nas skye shi'i rgyun chad de/ /'pho 'gyur med pa'i chos nyid byang chub sems/ /mkha' mnyam dbyings der rig pa'i gtan srid zungs/ /yon tan 'byung gnas dben pa bsten par mdzod/ /ces brjod pas/ dben par zhi ba'i ting 'dzin sgrub pa la spro bar gyur to/ /de nas rab tu byung ba des rjes su gdams pa'i gnas dang*/ ri bong gi mchog la rab tu dad pas bsngags pa/ e ma ho skye bo dam pa'i tshul/ /e ma ho ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas/ /e ma ho sngon med dag pa'i lha/ /e ma ho ya mtshan re che kwa/ /rgyu skar lam la rab gnas pa'i/ /mtshan mo'i mig kyang khyod mthong nas/ /zla zer gsal bas nam mkha' 'gengs/ /kun da'i gnyen gyis rgya cher bsngags/ /dud pa'i dpag bsam grib ma bzhin/ /phun tshogs yin yang phun tshogs 'gongs/ /khyod ni zhi ba'i gdangs gsal bas/

/rkang 'thung mang pos mtshon bya min/ /lha rnams kyis kyang khang bzang la/ khyod kyi gzugs brnyan rab bris shing*/ /rgyu skar bdag por gsal bar bkod/ /de phyir mchog tu bsngags pa lags/ /shes rab 'phags pas dbyangs can ma/ /nags khrod dag na drang srong bzhin/ /legs par 'doms pa'i bshes gnyen la/ /dad brgya'i 'dab stong g.yo bas mchod/ /ces brjod nas me tog gis gtor ro/ /de nas rab tu byung ba des/ ngo mtshar snang bas yid g.yos nas/ /dul ba'i ri bong mchog de la/ /bstod cing me tog char ba 'bebs/ /mkhas pa'i ri bong dam pa yang*/ /lhag par brtse ba'i chu 'dzin las/ /mkhyen rab mchog gi glog phreng dang*/ /mnyam du tshangs dbyangs 'brug stong sgrogs/ /rjes su gdams pa zab mo dang*/ /sa skyong phyogs kyi mthar khyab pa/ /yon tan mchog gi mchog gyur pa/ /rab gsal yid kyi thig ler gyur/ /de nas yang bsam pa/ blang dor gyi gnas la gdams pa de dag gi don khong du chud nas/ gnas de yongs su bsgrub par bya ba'i chos gang zhig yin snyam nas smras pa/ gang dag legs pa'i yon tan ku mu da/ /gsar du 'dzum pas yid mkha'i mtsho gter 'gengs/ /zhi ba'i 'dab stong dul ba'i ri bong mchog /chos dkar dge ba'i rang bzhin ston par mdzod/ /ces brjod pa na/ don de dam pa rnams kyis bsngags pa'i me tog phreng ba rgyun chags pa'i lam la 'jug pa'i phyir/ rim pa'i cha dbye bar 'dod nas ri bong gi mchog des smras pa/ gang zhig dam pa rnams kyis bsten pa'i chos/ /'jig rten dag na rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /mngon par mtho dang nges par legs pa'o/ /gnas skabs dang ni mthar thug phun tshogs bsgrub/ /ces brjod pa na/ yang dris pa/ mngon par mtho ba 'jig rten lha mi'i chos/ /dge ba de yang gang gis ji ltar sgrub/ /de yi rim pa ma nor nges pa'i don/ /yon tan rang bzhin can la mnyan par 'tshal/ /zhes brjod pa na/ ri bong gis smras pa/

mngon mtho'i chos ni dge ba 'jig rten gyi/ /'di phyi'i don gnyis sgrub la rag ltos nas/ /phun tshogs bsten dang legs pa gzhan gyi phyir/ /mthong dang ma mthong yon tan mchog 'grub byed/ /ces brjod pa na/ yang smras pa/ gang zhig bsten pas 'di nyid kyi/ /phun tshogs nyams pa bsrung 'gyur zhing*/ /dpal yang yar ngo'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /'phel ba'i thabs ni ji lta bu/ /ri bong gi mchog des smras pa/ tshe 'di'i dpal dang skal ba bzang po rnams/ /nyams par mi 'gyur 'phel ba'i thabs de yang*/ /mi dbang gling bzhi'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhin/ /rgyal srid dge ba bdun ltar bshad kyis nyon/ /rtag tu dge zhing brtan pa'i lte ba la/ /kun la sems snyoms phan bde'i mu khyud can/ /bsod nams rtsibs stong 'khor lo rin chen mdzod/ /skye rgus bstod cing kha lo bsgyur ba lags/ /sgo gsum dul zhing kun la snyan par smra/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs gsal spyod lam tshul du shes/ /bag yod zhi ba'i btsun mo rin chen mdzod/ /kun gyis mthong na yid du 'ong ba lags/ /phyi nang mtho dman che chung thams cad la/ /gang la ci 'dod sbyin pa'i char 'bebs pa/ /phyogs med btang ba'i nor bu rin chen mdzod/ /skye rgu 'du zhing 'dod rgu 'byung ba lags/ /don rnams kun la rigs pas sgrub pa dang*/ /gzhan gyis mi bskyod snyan khung 'thug pa dang*/ /thugs rgyud sgam pa'i blon po rin chen mdzod/ /thugs tshod mnga' bas chab srid brtan pa lags/ /rang gi sde rnams khur du bzhes pa dang*/ /dka' ba bzod pas don rnams sgrub pa dang*/ /brling zhing brtan pa'i glang po rin chen mdzod/ /thams cad brten pa'i dam par 'gyur ba lags/ /rang don gang yang brtson pas sgrub pa dang*/ /'jam zhing des la go rig phun sum tshogs/ /grim zhing dul ba'i rta mchog rin chen mdzod/ /rang gzhan mdzes shing legs rgu 'grub pa lags/ /thabs dang 'phrul gyis srid du bcad la sogs/

/pha rol dgra rnams ngang gis gzhom pa dang*/ /dpa' mdzangs brtan pa'i dmag dpon rin chen mdzod/ /kun dang mthun zhing 'gran zla med pa lags/ /zhes brjod pa dang*/ 'jig rten 'di'i legs pa sgrub pa'i tshul la mkhas par gyur to/ /yang phyi ma'i legs pa sgrub par 'dod nas smras pa/ gang zhig bsten pas phyi mar mngon mtho ba/ /sa bon mchog las myu gu 'byung ba bzhin/ /ma mthong chos la bslu ba med gyur pa/ /legs pa'i dam pa gang yin mnyan par 'tshal/ /zhes brjod pa dang*/ ri bong gimachog des smras pa/ yon tan rang bzhin can rnams ring gzigs pas/ /phyi ma'i legs pa sgrub pa mtha' yas kyang*/ /mi dbang nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun gyi/ /rjes su 'gro ba legs pa'i chos rab nyon/ /gang la 'dug pas mthon po'i mchog gyur pa/ /dge bcu'i mal khri nye ba'i rin po che/ /sgo gsum bsdams shing dam pa'i rjes 'gro bas/ /phyi mar rigs bzang phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /gang zhig bting nas mthong na mi mthun med/ /bzod pa'i stan mchog nye ba'i rin po che/ /khro ba spangs shing tshig 'jam snyan par smra/ /phyi mar gzugs mdzes phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /gang zhig reg pas rang gzhan bde byed pa/ /bsod nams pags pa nye ba'i rin po che/ /sbyin pa'i char gyis 'gro ba tshim par byed/ /phyi mar longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /gang zhig gyon pas dbang phyug phun sum tshogs/ /dul ba'i mchil lham nye ba'i rin po che/ /dam par bkur zhing gzhan gyis dgos pa sgrub/ /phyi mar btsan zhing phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /gang zhig zhon pas legs pa kun 'grub pa/ /dad mos bzhon pa nye ba'i rin po che/ /dad cing gus pas chos dkar dge ba 'phel/ /phyi mar dad pa phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /gang zhig thogs pas thams cad zil gnon pa/ /shes rab ral gri nye ba'i rin po che/ /blang dor gnas dang bzo rig gtsug lag sbyong*/ /phyi mar shes rab phun sum tshogs pa lags//zhes brjod pas/

mngon par mtho ba 'jig rten pa'i chos dge ba sgrub pa la mkhas par gyur to/ /yang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos dge ba 'dod nas smras pa/ gang la bsten nas srid pa rnams spangs shing*/ /thar pa dam pa mya ngan 'das pa'i chos/ /zag med rdul bral nyes pa med gyur pa/ /mchog tu zhi ba'i lam de gang zhig kye/ /ri bong gi mchog des smras pa/ 'jig rten 'das gang shin tu spros pa med/ /mkha' ltar dag cing rnam grangs rgya che yang*/ /thog ma bar dang tha mar 'jug pa'i tshul/ /bkra shis brgyad la brten nas bshad kyis nyon/ /dad pa'i dbu la rin chen gdugs mdzes kyi/ /bkra shis gang lags dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ /rab tu gus pas bkur sti rim gro bskyed/ /skyo ngal spongs la rtag tu mi 'bral mdzod/ /shes rab spyan la rig pa'i nya mchog gi

/bkra shis gang lags blo mig sbyangs pa ste/ /mdo rgyud don la thos bsam rgya che bas/ /rang bzhin blo yi mun pa sangs par mdzod/ /tshangs dbyangs gsung la grags pa'i dung mchog gi /bkra shis gang lags gzhan don rlabs che bas/ /dbang po'i rim bzhin 'gro la dam chos ston/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i phrin las phun tshogs mdzod/ /byams pa'i ljags la snying rje'i 'dab ma mchog /bkra shis gang lags byang chub sems mchog bskyed/ /smon dang 'jug pa'i rang bzhin rgya che bas/ /rgyal sras spyod pa dam pa'i lam bzang mdzod/ /tshul khrims mgul la yon tan bum pa mchog /bkra shis gang lags bslab gsum gtsang mar byed/ /dran dang shes bzhin bag yod gnyen po yis/ /mi dge spangs shing dge chos sgrub par mdzod/ /zhi ba'i thugs la ting 'dzin dpal be'u yi/ /bkra shis gang lags rtag tu mnyam par 'jog /zhi gnas lhag mthong thabs shes zung 'brel bas/ /rigs dang mngon shes yon tan mchog grub mdzod/ /brtson pa'i zhabs la dbang bsgyur 'khor lo yi/ /bkra shis gang lags rtag tu dge la spro/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun lam la/ /nyin mtshan mi dal 'bad pas sgrub par mdzod/ /bsod nams sku la mi nub rgyal mtshan gyi/ /bkra shis gang lags tshul khrims rgya mtsho sgrub/ /sa lam gong bgrod sgrib gnyis rab sbyangs nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ces brjod pas/ thar ba dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la mkhas shing spro bar gyur to/ /skal bzang skye bo'i khor gyi khyams nang du/ /legs 'doms chos kyi rnga chen snyan bsgrags pas/ /gdul bya bag med gnyid las slong ba dang*/ /yon tan dga' ba sngon med skyes 'di mtshar/ /de nas rab tu byung ba de dga' zhing mgu nas thal mo sbyar te/ dad pas lta zhing gus pas phyag 'tshal nas/ ri bong gi mchog de la bstod cing bsngags pa/ e ma mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor yangs/ /chos kun gsal par rab 'phro la/

/thugs rjes rnam grol mchog tu bstan/ /ston zla yi yang rjes su bsnyegs/ /tshangs par byed pas skyon bral la/ /skye rgu skyong bas brgya byin dang*/ /blo gros sbyin pas rgya mtsho yi/ /lha mo mchog la 'gran pa mtshar/ /'di ni rang bzhin mchog gcig pu/ /snyan dngags mkhan gzhan chen po min/ /kun gyis 'god par nus pa min/ /yon tan rang bzhin bkod la ltos/ /padma 'dam las rab 'thon la/ /rkang 'thungs sa las gyen du 'phags/ /khyod ni skye rgu'i steng 'dzegs pas/ /nam mkha'i nor bu kho nar zad/ /sngon gyi dus na'ang blo gsal ri bong zhig /yon tan grags pas mtshan la lha lam gyi/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ngos la gzugs bris zhes/ /grags pa gang de khyod kyis gsal bar byas/ /legs 'doms skye rgu'i nang nas pha dang ma/ /thar gling 'dod la ded dpon bla na med/ /chu chen sgrol la gru gzengs mnyan pa ste/ /re 'dod rnams kyi yid bzhin mchog de rgyal/ /thogs med bskal pa rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed nas/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rab rdzogs pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul ngo mtshar rmad byung bar/ /dad brgya'i 'dab stong g.yo bas gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes brjod de/ me tog gis snyim pa bkang bas mchod pa dang*/ de nas ri bong gi mchog des smras pa/ gang zhig snyan par smra ba dkon pa ste/ /de bas de la mchog tu nyan pa'ang dkon/ /grogs dag khyod kyang bzang por byed 'dod na/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu chos kyis 'da' bar mdzod/ /snyan pa'i bka' mchid 'di dag yid la zungs/ /phan pa'i gdams ngag lags kyis sems la zhog /brtse ba'i gros 'dun bzang po'i tshul la nyon/ /gnas 'di rgya cher gzhan la'ang spel bar mdzod/ /ces brjod nas ri bong gi mchog de rang gi gnas su song ngo*/ /de lta bas na skye bo thar pa 'dod pa dag gis/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gus pas bsten par bya ba dang*/ rjes su gdams pa zab mo'i gnas la blang dor du bya ba dang*/

phan par smra ba gzhan gyis legs par 'doms pa la gus pas nyan pa dang*/skye bo dam pa rnams kyi yon tan bsngags pa la rgya cher sbyar bar bya'o/ /dpag med chu ldan rim rgyas ge sar mtshor/ /rnam bkra'i gzugs brnyan dag ni snang ba ltar/ /mkhyen brtse'i blo mig rab rgyas chu gter du/ /snyan ngag nyer bkra'i gzugs brnyan shar ba lags/ /tshul 'di blo gros yangs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /rnam dpyod nyin byed 'od zer stong 'phro bas/ /phan bde'i me tog padmo 'dzum bya'i phyir/ /skal bzang thar pa 'dod rnams don du spro/ /gnas 'dir tshig rgyan gtso bor ma byas shing*/ /don rgyan legs pa 'ba' zhig dbang byas nas/ /blang dor tshul la rab tu gdams pa'i don/ /skye bo rnams kyi rtogs par sla phyir bshad/ /'di dag sngon byung bzhin du bkod pa yis/ /da lta'i mi dang phyi rabs dus kun na'ang*/ /ngo mtshar gtam gyi skyes su byed pa dang*/ /gzhan la phan 'gyur snyam nas legs par sbyar/ /dge ba de yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /dam chos rin chen shing rtar legs zhugs nas/ /thar pa zhi ba'i skyed mos tshal nang du/ /'chi med mya ngan 'das pa'i gnas thob shog /tshig don dpag bsam legs 'doms byang chub shing*/ /sdeb sbyor yal ga mngon brjod lo 'dab can/ /snyan dngags me tog 'bras bkra'i rang bzhin 'dis/ /dad ldan skye bo'i bya tshogs dga' bar mdzod/ /ces blo gsal ri bong gi rtogs pa brjod pa legs par 'doms pa lha'i rnga bo che lta bu'i gtam/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kyi gnas la mang du thos pa'i blo gros rgya che zhing*/ gangs ri'i khrod kyi snyan dngags mkhan rnams kyi nang nas khyu mchog tu gyur pa kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang pos lhun grub gling gi gnas su sbyar ba rdzogs so/ /buddha siddhā rd+ra sya ngharma bha bantu/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/
